引言

第 01 章 · 章节速读

这本书讨论一个核心问题：如何把仿真、优化和 AI 结合起来，在不确定的环境中做出更好的决策。

仿真：先试一试
在计算机中重现系统，观察不同方案可能产生的结果。
优化：选一个更好的方案
根据仿真结果比较方案，并合理分配有限的计算预算。
AI：从经验中学习
学习预测模型或决策策略，同时用仿真检验效果。

阅读顺序：仿真优化基础 → 机器学习 → 两者结合 → 实际应用。

展开章节全文

中文译文由机器翻译生成，并对专业术语和部分段落进行了校订。可随时切换英文原文对照阅读。

仿真与人工智能（AI）为分析和优化复杂动态系统提供了重要工具，其应用涵盖制造、供应链、交通、医疗、电信、呼叫中心和金融等关键领域。仿真通过模拟自然过程和人造过程来评估系统性能，使从业者能够预测结果、比较不同策略，为决策提供依据，而不必开展成本高昂的现实试验。然而，大规模随机系统的仿真需要大量计算资源：要达到所需的统计精度，准确的性能评估必须进行足够多次仿真重复。因此，早期对仿真模型的“优化”主要依靠试错和启发式算法，这些方法通常难以扩展，也缺乏最优性保证。过去几十年来，仿真与优化方法的融合取得了显著进展。Simulation and artificial intelligence (AI) provide essential tools for the analysis and optimization of complex dynamic systems found in critical application domains including manufacturing, supply chains, transportation, healthcare, telecommunications, call centers, and finance. Simulation emulates natural and man-made processes with the objective of evaluating system performance, enabling practitioners to inform their decision-making by predicting outcomes and assessing different strategies without costly real-world experiments. However, simulating large-scale stochastic systems necessitates substantial computational resources, as accurate performance assessments require a sufficient number of simulation replications to achieve desired statistical precision. Thus, early “optimization” of simulation models were primarily trial-and-error approaches and heuristic algorithms, which did not scale well and usually had no guarantees of optimality. Over the past few decades, significant strides have been made in the integration of simulation and optimization methods.

从历史上看，仿真和优化均已有数百年的发展，其根源可以追溯到牛顿和莱布尼茨。相比之下，AI 和蒙特卡洛（MC）方法都起源于 20 世纪中叶，MC 比 AI 大约早十年。MC 是本文重点讨论的随机仿真的基础，而“仿真优化”（SO）直到 20 世纪更晚的时候才成为常用术语。自诞生以来，AI 的重大进步呈现出一轮又一轮的发展浪潮，其推动力包括计算能力提升、算法创新和数据规模的指数增长。Historically, simulation and optimization are centuries-old fields, both tracing their roots back to Newton and Leibniz, whereas AI and the Monte Carlo (MC) method, which serves as the basis of stochastic simulation, the focus of this review, both originated in the mid-20th century (with MC preceding AI by about a decade), and simulation optimization (SO) did not become a common term until even later in the 20th century. Since its birth, major advances in AI have appeared to come in waves, with progress driven by advances in computational power, algorithmic innovation, and the exponential growth of data.

早期 AI 研究主要关注符号推理和基于规则的系统。先驱人物包括提出通用计算机器概念的艾伦·图灵，以及创造“人工智能”一词并提出 LISP 编程语言的约翰·麦卡锡。旨在模拟人类问题求解能力的 Logic Theorist 系统也是这一时期的代表。在相对短暂的发展历史中，AI 经历了快速进步，也经历了因预期落空和计算资源有限而出现的重大挫折，这些低潮常被称为“AI 寒冬”。近几十年的 AI 复兴最终催生了大语言模型（LLM），其基础是机器学习（ML），尤其是深度学习（DL）的突破。这些突破使模型能够以前所未有的准确性和效率处理海量数据并从中学习。Early AI research focused on symbolic reasoning and rule-based systems, following pioneers such as Alan Turing, who proposed the concept of a universal machine capable of performing any computation, and John McCarthy, who coined the term “artificial intelligence” and introduced the programming language LISP, and also exemplified by the development of the Logic Theorist, which aimed to emulate human problem-solving abilities. Over its relatively brief lifetime, AI has experienced periods of rapid progress followed by significant setbacks often referred to as “AI winters,” due to unmet expectations and limited computational resources. The resurgence of AI in recent decades, culminating in the development of large language models (LLMs), can be attributed to breakthroughs in machine learning (ML), particularly deep learning (DL), which have enabled the development of models capable of processing and learning from vast amounts of data with unprecedented accuracy and efficiency.

当前 AI 的“黄金时代”体现了从传统符号推理向现代数据驱动方法的范式转变。以 LLM 为代表的现代技术采用先进的 ML 方法和深层人工神经网络（ANN）架构，显著增强了自然语言理解与生成能力。作为现代 AI 的支柱，ML 致力于开发能够从数据中学习并据此预测的算法。监督学习、无监督学习和强化学习（RL）是其核心方法，分别适用于不同的问题和数据结构。DL 是 ML 的一个分支，通过多层 ANN 对数据中的复杂模式与表示进行建模，推动了计算机视觉、自然语言处理和语音识别等领域的突破。此外，RL 的进展使 AI 系统能够通过与环境交互来完成复杂决策任务，AlphaGo 及其后继系统的成功就是例证。The current “golden age” of AI reflects a paradigm shift from traditional symbolic reasoning to modern data-driven approaches. Contemporary techniques harness advanced ML and deep artificial neural network (ANN) architectures, as exemplified by LLMs, which significantly enhance natural language understanding and generative capabilities. ML, a pillar of modern AI, focuses on developing algorithms that allow systems to learn from and make predictions based on data. Supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and reinforcement learning (RL) are core methodologies of ML, each catering to different types of problems and data structures. DL, a specialized branch of ML, utilizes multi-layered ANNs to model complex patterns and representations in data, leading to breakthroughs in fields such as computer vision, natural language processing, and speech recognition. Additionally, advances in RL have empowered AI systems to excel in decision-making tasks through interactions with their environment, as demonstrated by the success of AlphaGo and its successors.

AI 的影响无处不在。在医疗领域，AI 模型辅助疾病诊断、个性化治疗规划和患者结局预测，从而提升医疗服务的质量与效率。在汽车行业，AI 支撑自动驾驶汽车的发展，使实时导航、障碍物检测和安全高效的交通决策成为可能。在金融领域，AI 用于算法交易、风险评估和欺诈检测，通过复杂模型分析市场趋势，并高精度地识别异常活动。The impact of AI can be found everywhere. In healthcare, AI-driven models assist in disease diagnosis, personalized treatment planning, and predictive analytics for patient outcomes, thereby enhancing the quality and efficiency of medical services. In the automotive industry, AI underpins the development of autonomous vehicles, enabling real-time navigation, obstacle detection, and decision-making to ensure safe and efficient transportation. The financial sector leverages AI for algorithmic trading, risk assessment, and fraud detection, utilizing sophisticated models to analyze market trends and detect anomalous activities with high precision.

在现代生活中，最显眼、最普遍的 AI 形态可能是基于生成式 LLM 的智能体，例如 OpenAI 的生成式预训练 Transformer（GPT）系列和 Google DeepMind 的 Gemini（原名 Bard）。这些由 LLM 驱动的 AI 智能体具备较强的语言理解与生成能力，能够执行复杂任务、开展自然语言对话，并在少量人工干预下适应新情境。相比通常由预设规则驱动的传统基于智能体的仿真（ABS）环境，它们的学习能力实现了巨大跃升。融入 LLM 后，AI 智能体的认知灵活性增强，交互和决策过程也更加动态。LLM 智能体与传统 ABS 的共同目标是对智能行为建模；不同之处在于，LLM 引入了语言和上下文理解能力，使智能体之间的沟通与学习能够被更逼真地仿真，从而丰富基于智能体的模型。However, the most conspicuous and ubiquitous presence of AI in modern life may be generative LLM-based agents such as OpenAI’s line of generative pre-trained transformers (GPTs) and Google DeepMind’s Gemini (formerly, Bard). These LLM-enabled AI agents possess advanced language understanding and generative capabilities, allowing them to perform complex tasks, engage in natural language dialogues, and adapt to new situations with minimal human intervention. Their learning ability represents a huge leap from traditional agent-based simulation (ABS) environments, which typically consist of agents with predefined rules. The integration of LLMs enhances the cognitive flexibility of AI agents, enabling more dynamic interactions and decision-making processes. The relationship between LLM-enabled AI agents and traditional ABS lies in their shared goal of modeling intelligent behavior; however, LLMs introduce a level of linguistic and contextual understanding that can enrich agent-based models by facilitating more realistic simulations of communication and learning among agents.

先看 AI 与 SO 研究之间的相互作用。AI/ML 的进展显著改进了仿真建模与分析，例如使用 ANN 作为代理模型，近似复杂随机仿真模型的输出。利用部分仿真输出数据训练 ANN 后，可以快速预测新输入参数下的结果，从而显著降低性能评估或优化问题中目标函数估计的计算负担。代理模型因此能够使优化计算量降低若干数量级，让实时集成仿真与优化成为可能，并为数字孪生（DT）技术提供路径，以支持动态环境中的不确定性决策。To give a preview of the interplay between research in AI and SO, advances in AI/ML have led to significant enhancements in simulation modeling and analysis, such as the use of ANNs as surrogate models to approximate the outputs of a complex stochastic simulation model. By training ANNs on a subset of simulation output data, accurate predictions for new input parameters can be rapidly generated, significantly reducing the computational burden for performance evaluation or estimating the objective function in an optimization problem. Thus, using surrogate models leads to orders of magnitudes reduction in computation in the optimization aspect, enabling real-time integrated simulation and optimization, providing a path to the digital twin (DT) technology supporting decision-making under uncertainty in dynamic environments.

此外，RL 等 AI 驱动的优化算法已被有效应用于基于智能体的系统等仿真框架。RL 智能体通过与仿真环境交互、不断试错，在复杂决策空间中学习最优策略，以最大化累积奖励。以仿真作为训练场，可以开展广泛试验，同时避免现实试验的风险与成本。这种做法已在自动驾驶汽车和智能机器人等自主系统的开发中体现出价值。方差缩减技术和自适应采样策略还可以把计算资源分配给输入空间中最关键的区域，从而进一步提高仿真输出的可靠性与精度。Furthermore, AI-driven optimization algorithms, such as RL, have been effectively applied within simulation frameworks, such as agent-based systems. RL agents interact with simulated environments to learn optimal decision-making strategies through trial-and-error, navigating complex decision spaces to maximize cumulative rewards. Using simulations as training grounds allows for extensive experimentation without incurring the risks and costs of real-world trials, a strategy that has proven valuable in the development of autonomous systems such as self-driving cars and intelligent robotics. In addition, variance reduction techniques and adaptive sampling strategies further refine simulation processes by allocating computational resources to the most critical regions of the input space, thereby enhancing both the reliability and precision of simulation outputs.

反过来，将 SO 技术融入 AI 应用也带来了重要的实际成果，例如采用 ANN 和蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的 AlphaGo 及其后继、衍生系统（AlphaGo Zero、AlphaZero、MuZero 和 AlphaFold）。AlphaGo 展示了 AI 与 SO 如何结合，以处理复杂的战略决策任务。它由 DeepMind 开发，利用深层 ANN 评估棋盘局面、预测潜在走法，从而捕捉围棋中复杂的模式与策略。MCTS 是其优异表现的核心：这种基于仿真的优化技术通过生成并评估大量可能的落子序列，系统地探索未来局面。AI 驱动的学习与基于仿真的搜索相结合，使 AlphaGo 能在探索新策略和利用已知高胜率走法之间取得平衡，进而击败人类冠军。此外，AlphaGo 利用 RL 进行大量自我对弈，不断改进策略网络与价值网络，逐步增强决策能力。这些 AI 方法与先进 SO 技术的融合，不仅促成了 AlphaGo 在围棋上的突破，也展示了混合方法解决其他领域复杂高维问题的潜力。通过深度强化学习（DRL）训练这些系统，以近似价值函数和策略函数，是实现超人类表现的重要环节，也凸显了 SO 方法在 AI 技术中的作用。Conversely, the incorporation of SO techniques into AI applications has also led to notable real-world success stories, such as AlphaGo and its successors and progeny (AlphaGo Zero, AlphaZero, MuZero, and AlphaFold), which employ ANNs and Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS). AlphaGo exemplifies the fusion of AI and SO in addressing complex strategic decision-making tasks. Developed by DeepMind, AlphaGo utilizes deep ANNs to evaluate board positions and predict potential moves, thereby effectively capturing the intricate patterns and strategies inherent in the game of Go. Central to its remarkable performance is the implementation of MCTS, a simulation-based optimization technique that systematically explores possible future game states by generating and assessing numerous potential move sequences. This synergy between AI-driven learning and simulation-based search enables AlphaGo to balance the exploration of novel strategies with the exploitation of known high-probability moves, resulting in superior performance against human champions. Additionally, AlphaGo incorporates RL to continuously refine its policy and value networks through extensive self-play, thereby enhancing its decision-making capabilities over time. The confluence of these AI methodologies with advanced SO not only facilitated AlphaGo’s unprecedented victories in Go but also demonstrated the potential of hybrid approaches in solving other complex, high-dimensional problems across various domains. Furthermore, the training of these systems through deep reinforcement learning (DRL) to approximate value and policy functions has been instrumental in achieving superhuman performance, highlighting the important role that SO methods play in AI technologies.

AI 对 SO 的价值，来自它从海量数据中学习、识别复杂模式并准确预测的能力。ML 可以构建易于融入仿真框架的预测模型，提高框架的准确性与效率。例如，DL 模型能够近似仿真中复杂的输入—输出关系，从而提高优化精度，并降低传统仿真方法的计算负担。AI 与 SO 的这种协同正越来越多地用于处理常规优化技术难以求解的高维和非线性问题。借助 AI 的预测能力，SO 方法能够同时改善速度与准确性。AI’s relevance in the context of SO stems from its capacity to learn from vast datasets, identify intricate patterns, and make accurate predictions. ML facilitates the development of predictive models that can be seamlessly incorporated into simulation frameworks, thereby enhancing their accuracy and efficiency. For instance, DL models are capable of approximating complex input-output relationships within simulations, which allows for more precise optimization and reduces the computational burden associated with traditional simulation methods. This synergy between AI and SO is increasingly being leveraged to address high-dimensional and non-linear problems that are otherwise challenging to solve using conventional optimization techniques. By harnessing the predictive power of AI, SO methods can achieve superior performance in terms of both speed and accuracy.

AI 与 SO 融合的一项重要进展，是把 RL 应用于 SO。Q-learning、策略梯度等 RL 算法，在优化仿真环境中的序贯决策问题方面展现了很大潜力。它们通过“试错”（采样与反馈）学习最优策略，因此特别适用于传统优化方法往往难以应对的动态复杂系统。RL 在 SO 中的应用包括机器人控制、自主系统和智能电网管理。例如，在机器人控制中，RL 使机器人能够通过与环境交互来学习最优运动策略，提高适应性和效率。在自主系统中，RL 支持实时决策与优化，这对于自动驾驶汽车等自主技术的安全高效运行至关重要。One of the most significant advances in the integration of AI and SO is the application of RL for SO. RL algorithms, such as Q-learning and policy gradient methods, have demonstrated remarkable promise in optimizing sequential decision-making problems within simulated environments. These algorithms are able to learn optimal policies through a “trial-and-error” paradigm (sampling and feedback), making them exceptionally well-suited for dynamic and complex systems where traditional optimization techniques often fall short. The application of RL in SO is evident in various domains, including robotic control, autonomous systems, and smart grid management. In robotic control, for example, RL algorithms enable robots to learn optimal movement strategies through interaction with their environment, thereby enhancing their adaptability and efficiency. Similarly, in autonomous systems, RL facilitates real-time decision-making and optimization, which are crucial for the safe and efficient operation of self-driving vehicles and other autonomous technologies.

ANN 是现代 AI 的基础，其训练过程本身就可以表述为 SO 问题。特别是在 DL 和 RL 场景中，ANN 训练高度依赖随机梯度估计，以调整网络参数并最小化损失函数。随机梯度下降（SGD）及其变体是有效训练 ANN 的基本技术，使网络能够从大规模数据中学习复杂模式与表示。源于多臂老虎机（MAB）问题的树置信上界算法（UCT），是 MCTS 中平衡探索与利用的常用节点选择策略。随机梯度估计中的方差缩减技术可以减轻参数搜索轨迹的振荡，从而加速 ANN 训练。此外，通过仿真降低动作价值函数估计的方差，可以提高 MCTS 节点选择的准确性，使决策更可靠、更有效。这些进展体现了 AI 与 SO 的相互促进：优化技术提高 AI 模型的性能与可靠性，AI 方法又反过来优化复杂的仿真系统。ANNs form the backbone of modern AI, with their training processes inherently formulated as SO problems. The training of ANNs, particularly in DL and RL contexts, relies heavily on stochastic gradient estimation, which is crucial for adjusting network parameters to minimize loss functions. Techniques such as stochastic gradient descent (SGD) and its variants are fundamental to the effective training of ANNs, enabling them to learn complex patterns and representations from large datasets. The upper confidence bound algorithm for trees (UCT), derived from the multi-armed bandit (MAB) problem, is a popular node selection policy in MCTS for balancing exploration and exploitation. Variance reduction techniques for stochastic gradient estimation play a critical role in mitigating the oscillations of parameter search trajectories, thereby accelerating the training process of ANNs. Moreover, reducing the variance of the estimated action-value function through simulations enhances the accuracy of node selection policies in MCTS, leading to more reliable and effective decision-making processes. These advances highlight the synergistic interplay between AI and SO, where optimization techniques enhance the performance and reliability of AI models, and AI-driven methods, in turn, optimize complex simulation-based systems.

将 AI 融入 SO 方法，还可以缓解传统优化技术的若干固有限制，尤其是在处理高维和非线性问题时。传统优化方法用于大规模复杂系统时，常常受制于可扩展性和计算效率。DL 与 RL 提供了可扩展的方案，能够有效处理高维数据和非线性关系。DL 可以近似非线性函数、捕捉数据中的复杂依赖，从而实现更准确高效的优化。RL 则能够随环境变化动态调整，并实时优化决策，相比静态优化具有显著优势。这种能力对自主系统、实时资源管理等需要即时适应与优化的应用尤为重要。例如，在制造系统中结合 DL 模型与 SO 技术，可以更精确地优化生产调度、缩短提前期并减少停机时间。在供应链管理中，AI 与 SO 也被用于优化库存水平和配送物流，提高响应能力并降低运营成本。Moreover, the integration of AI into SO methodologies addresses several inherent limitations of traditional optimization techniques, particularly in dealing with high-dimensional and non-linear problems. Traditional optimization methods often struggle with scalability and computational efficiency when applied to large-scale, complex systems. AI techniques such as DL and RL offer scalable solutions that can efficiently handle the complexities associated with high-dimensional data and non-linear relationships. DL models can effectively approximate non-linear functions and capture intricate dependencies within data, enabling more accurate and efficient optimization. Similarly, RL algorithms can dynamically adapt to changing environments and optimize decision-making processes in real-time, providing significant advantages over static optimization methods. This capability is particularly valuable in applications such as autonomous systems and real-time resource management, where the ability to adapt and optimize on the fly is essential for maintaining optimal performance. For example, integrating DL models with SO techniques in manufacturing systems leads to more precise optimization of production schedules, reducing lead times and minimizing downtime. Similarly, in supply chain management, AI and SO approaches have optimized inventory levels and distribution logistics, resulting in enhanced responsiveness and reduced operational costs.

AI 技术通过自动化并加速最优解搜索，显著提高了 SO 的计算效率。传统 SO 方法往往需要大量仿真来探索不同情景，因此计算开销较大。AlphaRank 是一种用于改进 SO 的先进 AI 方法，针对管理、工程和金融领域普遍存在的排序与选择（R\(\&\)S）问题。在这类 R\(\&\)S 任务中，需要在不确定条件下从许多候选方案中识别最优方案，而且通常受到有限仿真预算的约束。AlphaRank 将 DRL 与蒙特卡洛仿真结合，把采样决策过程建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），以刻画实现最优选择所需的序贯决策。其关键创新之一，是使用离线预训练的神经网络，在探索和利用之间取得适当平衡，从而支持快速、高效的实时决策：探索是考察测试较少的方案以降低不确定性，利用则是把资源集中到估计性能较高的方案。此外，AlphaRank 采用可并行的计算框架，结合“分而治之”和递归策略，高效处理包含数千乃至数百万候选方案的大规模 R\(\&\)S 问题。这种 AI 与 SO 的融合使 AlphaRank 能够解决过去难以处理的问题，为各行业的创新和运营改进提供工具。AI techniques significantly enhance the computational efficiency of SO by automating and accelerating the search for optimal solutions. Traditional SO methods often require extensive computational resources due to the need for numerous simulation runs to explore different scenarios. AlphaRank is an advanced AI methodology designed to enhance SO by addressing Ranking and Selection (R\(\&\)S) problems prevalent in management, engineering, and finance. R\(\&\)S tasks involve identifying the optimal option among numerous alternatives under uncertain conditions, often constrained by limited simulation budgets. AlphaRank integrates DRL with Monte Carlo simulations, modeling the sampling decision-making process as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) to effectively capture sequential decisions for optimal selection. A key innovation is the use of pre-trained neural networks, developed offline, which enable rapid and efficient real-time decision-making by striking the right balance between exploration – investigating less-tested alternatives to reduce uncertainty, and exploitation – focusing resources on options with high estimated performance. Moreover, AlphaRank employs a parallelizable computing framework with “divide-and-conquer” and recursion strategies, allowing it to efficiently manage large-scale R\(\&\)S problems involving thousands to millions of alternatives. This integration of AI and SO methodologies positions AlphaRank as a transformative tool, driving significant innovations and enabling superior operational excellence across various industries by resolving previously intractable problems.

AI 与 SO 的融合将通过跨学科合作和技术创新推动重要进展。DL、RL 等先进 AI 算法的持续改进，以及仿真建模和优化技术的不断发展，将显著拓展集成方法的能力与应用范围。高性能计算基础设施的扩张和大规模数据的日益可得，使研究者能够处理与分析规模更大、细节更丰富的仿真模型，从而实现更全面高效的优化。此外，运筹学、计算机科学和工程等领域的合作，有望产生新的方法和解决方案，构建发挥 AI 与 SO 互补优势的稳健框架。这种跨学科协同将提升复杂系统建模、预测与决策优化能力，应用于自主系统、医疗和可持续能源等多个领域。The convergence of AI and SO will drive significant advances through interdisciplinary collaboration and technological innovation. The ongoing refinement of advanced AI algorithms such as DL and RL, in conjunction with progressive enhancements in simulation modeling and optimization techniques, will significantly broaden the capabilities and applications of these integrated methodologies. The expansion of high-performance computing infrastructure and the increasing availability of extensive datasets will facilitate the management and analysis of larger, more detailed simulation models, enabling more comprehensive and efficient optimization processes. Furthermore, collaborative efforts across diverse fields such as operations research, computer science, and engineering are expected to generate novel approaches and solutions, fostering the development of robust frameworks that synergize the complementary strengths of AI and SO. This multidisciplinary synergy will enhance the ability to model complex systems, improve predictive accuracy, and optimize decision-making processes across various domains, including autonomous systems, healthcare, and sustainable energy.

本综述的范围与结构Scope and Organization of this Review

AI、仿真和优化都是广阔的领域，任何综述都必须有所取舍。如本章所述，我们关注随机动态系统中 RL 与 SO 的相互作用和协同，这可能是 AI/ML 与 SO 之间最自然、发展最充分的一种结合。这种作用是双向的，策略梯度搜索、Q-learning、MCTS 和神经网络训练都是例子。为方便不同领域的读者理解，我们先介绍仿真建模与分析基础，再讨论后续研究最相关的仿真和随机优化主题：根据带噪声观测从给定候选集中进行离散优化，对连续决策变量进行梯度搜索，马尔可夫决策过程，对带噪声输出函数估计梯度，以及随机仿真模型的方差缩减技术。随后概述 AI/ML 的多个主题，包括线性与逻辑回归、支持向量机和决策树，为主要内容 ANN（含梯度估计）与 RL 做铺垫。我们自己的 SO 研究最终面向决策，即规范性或处方性的行动，而不仅是描述或预测；RL 研究不确定性下的序贯决策，因此与这一目标十分契合。AI is a vast field, as are simulation and optimization, so any review must necessarily make choices on coverage. As indicated in this introduction, we will focus on the interaction and synergy between RL and SO for stochastic dynamic systems, perhaps the most natural and well-developed synergy between AI/ML and SO. The interaction goes both ways, as exemplified by methodologies such as policy gradient search, Q-learning, Monte Carlo tree search, and the training of neural networks. To enhance accessibility to an audience from diverse fields, we begin with background material on basic simulation modeling and analysis, and then focus on the simulation and stochastic optimization topics most relevant to the later discussion of research between SO and AI/ML: discrete optimization with noisy observations from a set of given alternatives, gradient-based search for continuous-valued decision variables, Markov decision processes, estimation of gradients for noisy output functions, and variance reduction techniques for stochastic simulation models. This is followed by an overview of a broad range of AI/ML topics, including linear and logistic regression, support vectors machines, and decision trees, as a prelude to the main topics of ANNs (also including gradient estimation) and RL. Because our own research in SO is ultimately driven by making decisions (prescriptive behavior), as opposed to descriptive or predictive models, RL aligns well, since it addresses sequential decision making under uncertainty.

因此，本综述首先在第 2 章介绍所需的仿真与优化背景，第 3 章介绍 AI/ML 基础，第 4 章讨论两者的协同，第 5 章介绍应用与案例。我们希望这些内容能为计算机科学、应用数学、运筹学与管理科学，以及大多数工程领域的研究者和研究生所理解并感兴趣；工程领域包括系统与工业工程、电气与计算机工程、机械工程、航空工程、土木工程和化学工程。读者可能只需具备本科层次、以微积分为基础的概率论知识，即了解积分和微分，而不必掌握测度论。先讲仿真与优化、后讲 AI/ML 是有意的安排：具有 AI/ML 背景的读者可以方便地跳过第 3 章，而除了人数较少、以 SO 为主要研究方向的群体之外，其他读者通常都能从两个背景章节中受益。许多运筹学与管理科学研究生项目甚至不要求学习随机仿真课程；工业工程课程也未必涵盖随机梯度估计，除非所在学校恰好有相关研究团队。此外，第 2 章的优化内容专门聚焦统计排序与选择（在离散集合上进行随机优化），以及基于随机梯度的搜索（对连续集合中的变量进行随机优化）。这些主题通常不属于 OR/MS 研究生数学规划与优化课程的标准内容，后者一般包括线性规划、凸规划、整数规划、非线性规划和随机规划。Thus, the review is structured to present the specific required background on simulation and optimization first in Chapter 2, followed by basic AI/ML topics in Chapter 3, and the synergies between the two in Chapter 4, followed by applications and case studies in Chapter 5. The material should be accessible and of interest (we hope!) to researchers and graduate students from computer science, applied mathematics, operations research & management science, and most engineering fields (e.g., systems & industrial engineering, electrical & computer engineering, mechanical engineering, aeronautical engineering, civil engineering, and chemical engineering). Perhaps the only prerequisite is an undergraduate-level course in calculus-based probability (integration and differentiation but no measure theory required). The choice of placing the simulation and optimization material before the AI/ML material was deliberate. Although we hope to reach a wide audience, the dichotomy between those with an AI/ML background and those without any such training is such that the former can easily skip Chapter 3, whereas most others except the far smaller community of researchers whose primary focus is SO, would benefit from reading both background chapters. In particular, many graduate operations research and management science programs do not even require a stochastic simulation course, whereas industrial engineering courses may not cover topics like stochastic gradient estimation (or only at the universities where that select set of researchers resides). Furthermore, the topics that are reviewed in the optimization sections of Chapter 2 narrowly focus on the specific topics of statistical ranking & selection (for stochastic optimization over a discrete set) and stochastic gradient-based search (for stochastic optimization over variables taking values from a continuous set), which lie outside the standard OR/MS graduate curriculum in mathematical programming/optimization (linear programming, convex programming, integer programming, nonlinear programming, stochastic programming).

具体而言，后文结构如下。第 2 章概述主要随机仿真方法——蒙特卡洛、离散事件和基于智能体的仿真，介绍与本综述最相关的离散及连续随机优化，讲解基本随机梯度估计方法，并总结若干对 AI 有用的方差缩减技术。第 3 章概述相关 AI 方法，包括传统回归与分类、DL、RL、计算机视觉和自然语言处理。第 4 章介绍结合 SO 与 AI/ML 的高级主题，例如用于神经网络训练的前向学习、策略梯度、Q-learning 探索、MCTS，以及 AI 增强的 SO。第 5 章将这些方法应用于运营与供应链管理，并展示若干案例和近期发展。To be specific, the rest of this review is organized as follows. In Chapter 2, we overview the main stochastic simulation approaches (Monte Carlo, discrete-event, and agent-based), introduce the most relevant areas of discrete and continuous stochastic optimization for our discussion, cover the basic stochastic gradient estimation methods, and summarize several variance reduction techniques useful for AI. Chapter 3 summarizes the AI methodologies relevant to our discussions, namely traditional regression and classification methods, DL, RL, computer vision, and natural language processing. Chapter 4 delves into advanced topics that draw from both SO and AI/ML, such as forward learning for neural network training, policy gradient methods, Q-learning exploration, and MCTS, alongside AI-enhanced SO. Chapter 5 applies these methodologies to operations and supply chain management and presents several case studies and recent developments.

展开章节全文

中文译文由机器翻译生成，并对专业术语和部分段落进行了校订。可随时切换英文原文对照阅读。

进入21世纪后，仿真优化领域通过将随机仿真技术和先进的优化算法结合起来取得了显著进展。研究人员证明，这种组合可以有效应对那些高不确定性系统带来的复杂挑战。随机仿真成为了管理随机性和变异性的强大工具，扩展了随机优化方法在各个学科的应用范围，同时也开发出了针对随机仿真环境量身定制的新优化方法。Entering the 21st century, the field of simulation optimization experienced significant progress through the integration of stochastic simulation techniques and advanced optimization algorithms. Researchers demonstrated that this combination could effectively address complex challenges posed by systems characterized by high levels of uncertainty. Stochastic simulation emerged as a powerful tool to manage randomness and variability, expanding the scope and applicability of stochastic optimization methods across various disciplines, and new optimization methodologies were developed that were tailored to the stochastic simulation setting.

计算能力的提升和算法的发展显著改变了 SO 的研究格局。随机环境下梯度估计技术的改进，使优化算法能够通过更少的仿真迭代得到精确的梯度信息，从而更高效地运行。这些创新对高维优化尤其有价值，因为传统梯度估计技术在此类问题中往往计算负担很重。此外，研究人员提出了改进的仿真采样分配策略，有针对性地在不同候选方案之间分配计算资源，在保持解的精度的同时减少计算开销。这些策略对控制计算需求、提高候选解探索效率起到了关键作用。方差缩减方法也已成为 SO 的重要组成部分，通过系统地减少随机仿真中固有的变异性，显著提高结果的精度和可靠性。这些进展大幅增强了优化结果的稳健性。Advances in computational capabilities and algorithmic developments have considerably transformed the landscape of SO. Enhanced techniques for estimating gradients in stochastic contexts allow optimization algorithms to operate more efficiently by generating precise gradient information from fewer simulation iterations. Such innovations have proven especially valuable in addressing high-dimensional optimization scenarios, where conventional gradient estimation techniques tend to be computationally burdensome. Furthermore, researchers introduced improved simulation sampling allocation strategies, designed to strategically distribute computational resources across different alternatives, thereby reducing computational overhead while preserving solution accuracy. These strategies have been pivotal in managing computational demands, facilitating more effective exploration of possible solutions. Moreover, variance reduction methods have become essential components in SO, significantly improving the accuracy and reliability of results by systematically reducing variability inherent in stochastic simulations. Such advances have contributed greatly to the robustness of optimization outcomes.

本章回顾随机仿真与优化所需的基础方法。第 2.1 节介绍三类主要随机仿真模型：蒙特卡洛（MC）仿真、离散事件仿真（DES）和基于智能体的仿真（ABS）。第 2.2 节和第 2.3 节分别讨论离散随机优化与连续随机优化：前者重点介绍非搜索方法，包括统计排序与选择及多臂老虎机模型，后者重点介绍基于梯度的搜索方法。第 2.4 节概述马尔可夫决策过程，为第 3 章的强化学习内容做准备。第 2.5 节介绍随机梯度估计，这是连续优化中基于梯度的搜索算法的关键。最后，第 2.6 节简要总结若干最有效的方差缩减技术，强调它们在提高仿真结果可靠性与精度方面的作用。这些基础内容为第 4 节中将仿真与优化同 AI 相结合的算法和应用做好铺垫。This chapter reviews the fundamental methodologies essential for stochastic simulation and optimization. Section 2.1 reviews the three main approaches for stochastic simulation models: Monte Carlo (MC) simulation, discrete event simulation (DES), and agent-based simulation (ABS). Discrete and continuous stochastic optimization are reviewed in Sections 2.2 and 2.3, respectively, where the treatment focuses on non-search methods for the former (statistical ranking & selection, and multi-armed bandit models) and gradient-based search methods for the latter, and the basics of Markov decision processes are summarized in Section 2.4, in preparation for reinforcement learning in Chapter 3. Stochastic gradient estimation, the linchpin of gradient-based search for continuous optimization algorithms, is presented in Section 2.5. Finally, the most effective variance reduction techniques are briefly summarized in Section 2.6, emphasizing their role in improving the reliability and precision of simulation outcomes. This overview sets the stage for the algorithms and applications integrating simulation and optimization with AI presented in Section 4.

2.1 随机仿真2.1 Stochastic Simulation

随机仿真可以用于分析那些本质上具有随机性和不确定性的复杂系统。我们回顾了三种主要的方法：蒙特卡洛仿真（MC模拟）、离散事件仿真（DES）和基于智能体的仿真（ABS）。MC模拟通过重复的随机抽样来近似解决复杂的确定性问题。DES则通过一系列离散、按时间顺序排列的事件来建模系统，可以详细了解运营动态和关键性能指标，比如流程时间和资源利用率，这对优化制造、物流和服务系统非常重要。ABS在DES的基础上进一步扩展，加入了具有自主行为和决策能力的个体智能体，从而能够模拟复杂的自适应系统，以及微观交互如何产生宏观现象。 面向对象编程和人工智能的结合进一步提升了ABS的复杂性和适用性，使模型更加真实和自适应。这些随机仿真技术为研究人员和实践者提供了强大且多功能的工具，用于在各个领域中建模、分析和优化系统，同时持续的进展保证了它们在应对不确定环境中的多方面挑战时仍然具有相关性和有效性。Stochastic simulation enables the analysis of complex systems characterized by inherent randomness and uncertainty. We review three principal methodologies: MC simulation, DES, and ABS. MC simulation leverages repeated random sampling to approximate solutions to intricate deterministic problems. DES models systems through a sequence of discrete, time-ordered events, providing detailed insights into operational dynamics and performance metrics like flow time and resource utilization, making it essential for optimizing manufacturing, logistics, and service systems. ABS extends the DES paradigm by incorporating autonomous agents with individual behaviors and decision-making capabilities, facilitating the simulation of complex adaptive systems and the emergence of macro-level phenomena from micro-level interactions. The integration of object-oriented programming and AI has further enhanced the sophistication and applicability of ABS, allowing for more realistic and adaptive models. These stochastic simulation techniques offer robust and versatile tools for researchers and practitioners to model, analyze, and optimize systems across diverse domains, with ongoing advances ensuring their continued relevance and efficacy in addressing multifaceted challenges in uncertain environments.

蒙特卡洛方法 The Monte Carlo Method

MC 方法利用统计采样估计积分等量，在这里这些积分通常表示期望值。为介绍 MC 方法的基本思想，考虑计算 \[\int_0^1 g(x) dx,\]；直接对函数 \(g\) 进行数值积分较为困难。The MC method employs statistical sampling for estimating quantities such as integrals, which in our setting usually represent expected values. To introduce the main idea of the MC method, consider calculating \[\int_0^1 g(x) dx,\] where direct integration of the function \(g\) is numerically challenging.

由容量为 \(n\) 的样本构造的 MC 估计量为Then the MC estimator based on a sample of size \(n\) is given by

\[\begin{equation} \frac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^{n} g(X_i), \end{equation}\]

其中 \(X_1, X_2, \ldots, X_n,\) 只是随机数字，即在区间 \([0,1]\) 上均匀分布的随机变量，记作 \(U(0,1)\)。对于给定的 \(n\)，MC 估计量是无偏的，如果 \(\{ X_i \}\) 是不相关的，那么大数定律 (LLN) 保证它也是一致的，也就是说，当样本量 \(n\) 趋于无穷大时，它会收敛到目标值。where \(X_1, X_2, \ldots, X_n,\) are simply random numbers, i.e., random variables uniformly distributed on the interval \([0,1]\), written as \(U(0,1)\). For a given \(n\), the MC estimator is unbiased, and if \(\{ X_i \}\) are uncorrelated, then the law of large numbers (LLN) ensures that it is also consistent, i.e., converges to the target value as the sample size \(n\) goes to infinity.

将 MC 方法用于随机仿真时，可以把积分视为仿真模型输出性能指标的期望值，即Application of the MC method for stochastic simulation views integrals as expected value output performance measures from a simulation model, viz.,

\[\begin{equation} \mathbb{E}[g(X)] = \int g(x) f(x) dx, \end{equation}\]

其中，\(g\) 是输出性能指标，\(X \sim f\) 是仿真输入，\(f\) 是输入的概率密度函数（p.d.f.）。对于上述简单例子，输入的概率密度函数是 \(U(0,1)\) 分布的密度，具体为where \(g\) is the output performance measure, and \(X \sim f\) is the simulation input, with \(f\) the input probability density function (p.d.f.). For the simple example, the input p.d.f. is the \(U(0,1)\) density given by

\[f(x) = {\bf 1}\{0 \leq x \leq 1\}.\]

MC 估计器（2.1）可以用来估计多维积分中如公式（2.2）所示形式的期望值，适用于一般的 \(f\)，在这种情况下，\(f\) 将表示联合概率密度函数，每个 \(X_i\) 则是根据 \(f\) 生成的输入随机变量向量。对于高维问题来说，MC 方法在计算上的优势非常明显，因为它的计算量随维度线性增长，而像辛普森法或高斯求积法这样的标准（确定性）数值积分方法则会呈指数增长。此外，MC 方法的统计特性使得估计器的精度可以直接测量，而这在确定性方法中并不总是可行；中心极限定理（CLT）也为构建（渐近有效的）置信区间提供了数学上的严格依据。The MC estimator (2.1) can be used to estimate expectations of the form given in Equation (2.2) for multi-dimensional integrals with general \(f\), in which case \(f\) would represent a joint p.d.f. and each \(X_i\) would be a vector of input random variables generated according to \(f\). The computational advantages of the MC method over standard (deterministic) numerical integration methods become apparent for high-dimensional problems, because its computational requirements grow linearly with the dimension, in contrast to the exponential increase in computation required by methods such as Simpson’s rule or Gaussian quadrature. Furthermore, its statistical nature allows straightforward measures of precision for the estimators not always available for deterministic procedures, and the central limit theorem (CLT) provides a mathematically rigorous basis for constructing (asymptotically valid) confidence intervals.

一个将在之后用于更详细讨论离散事件仿真、随机梯度估计（第2.5节）和方差缩减技术（第2.6节）的例子是单服务台排队系统，其中输入随机变量会影响顾客到达过程（到达间隔时间）和顾客服务时间，而感兴趣的输出性能指标包括排队时间（例如顾客在系统中花费的平均时间）和队列长度。An example to be utilized in more detail later for discrete-event simulation, stochastic gradient estimation (Section 2.5), and variance reduction techniques (Section 2.6) is a single-server queue, where the input random variables would drive both the customer arrival process (interarrival times) and the customer service times, and output performance measures of interest include queueing times (e.g., average time spent by customers in the system) and queue lengths.

马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC） Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC)

实现MC方法假设可以从输入分布\(f\)中生成样本，对于输入分布为\(U(0,1)\)的简单例子，这只是一个（伪）随机数生成器。马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）则考虑这样一种情况：从这种分布中生成样本本身就是有挑战性的，比如当它是高维度的时候。在这里，我们在目标分布为离散且有限的情况下展示经典的Metropolis-Hastings算法，因此按照通常的符号习惯，将目标分布记为\(\pi:= \{ \pi_i \}\)。MCMC的核心思想是构建一个合适的马尔可夫链，使其平稳分布为\(\pi\)。假设基础转移动态处于平稳状态，即时间齐次的马尔可夫链，我们将马尔可夫链的一步转移概率记为\(\{ p_{ij} \}\)。Implementing the MC method assumes the availability of generating from the input distribution \(f\), which would just be a (pseudo-)random number generator for the simple example where the input distribution is \(U(0,1)\). Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) considers the situation where generating from such a distribution is itself challenging, such as when it is of high dimensions. Here, we illustrate the classical Metropolis-Hastings algorithm in the setting where the target distribution is discrete and finite, and hence denote the target distribution by \(\pi:= \{ \pi_i \}\), following the usual notational convention. The main idea behind MCMC is to construct an appropriate Markov chain whose stationary distribution is \(\pi\). Assuming stationarity of the underlying transition dynamics, i.e., a time-homogeneous Markov chain, denote the one-step transition probabilities of the Markov chain by \(\{ p_{ij} \}\).

Metropolis-Hastings 算法通过使用一个基于提议的一步转移概率 \(\{ q_{ij} \}\) 的接受-拒绝程序来指定 \(\{ p_{ij} \}\)，从而构建出具有所需平稳分布 \(\pi\) 的马尔可夫链。具体来说，给定当前状态 \(X_n = i\)，会根据 \(q_{ij}\) 提议一个新状态 \(j\)，并以概率 \[\alpha_{ij} = \min\left( \frac{\pi_j q_{ji}}{\pi_i q_{ij}}, 1 \right).\] 接受该提议的状态转移。如果提议被拒绝，链将保持在当前状态 \(i\)。如果我们用 \(\{ p_{ij} \}\) 表示使用这种“接受-拒绝”程序生成的马尔可夫链的一步转移概率，那么可以证明 \(\{ p_{ij} \}\) 满足详细平衡条件 \[\pi_i p_{ij} = \pi_j p_{ji}, \quad \forall i, j,\]，从而保证 \(\pi\) 是该链的平稳分布。The Metropolis-Hastings algorithm constructs a Markov chain with the desired stationary distribution \(\pi\) by specifying \(\{ p_{ij} \}\) using an acceptance-rejection procedure based on a proposal set of one-step transition probabilities \(\{ q_{ij} \}\). Specifically, given the current state \(X_n = i\), a new state \(j\) is proposed according to \(q_{ij}\), and the proposed state transition is accepted with probability (w.p.) \[\alpha_{ij} = \min\left( \frac{\pi_j q_{ji}}{\pi_i q_{ij}}, 1 \right).\] If the proposal is rejected, the chain remains in the current state \(i\). If we let \(\{ p_{ij} \}\) denote the resulting one-step transition probabilities for the Markov chain generated using this “acceptance-rejection” procedure for state transitions, then it can be shown that \(\{ p_{ij} \}\) satisfy the detailed balance conditions \[\pi_i p_{ij} = \pi_j p_{ji}, \quad \forall i, j,\] thereby guaranteeing that \(\pi\) is the stationary distribution of the chain.

需要注意的是，MCMC 会生成相关的样本，因此在应用像大数定律（LLN）和中心极限定理（CLT）这样的经典统计定理时需要更加小心。另外，对于很多应用来说，通过在低维空间上的条件分布生成高维分布的样本，比直接使用完整的联合分布要容易得多。Gibbs 采样可能是这种方法最著名的例子。另一个对随机过程很有用的推广是序贯蒙特卡洛，也叫粒子滤波。It is critical to note that MCMC generates correlated samples, so that more care is needed in applying classical statistical theorems such as the LLN and CLT. Also, for many applications, it is easier to generate from high-dimensional distributions by using conditional distributions on lower-dimensional spaces rather than trying to use the full joint distribution. Gibbs sampling is perhaps the most prominent example of this approach. Another useful generalization for stochastic processes is sequential Monte Carlo, also known as particle filtering.

序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）与粒子滤波 Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) or Particle Filtering

序贯蒙特卡洛(SMC)将MCMC的原理扩展到目标分布随时间变化的动态系统，因此它们特别适合状态空间模型。SMC的目标是估计一系列后验分布\(\{ \pi^{(k)} \}\)，这些分布会逐步接近目标分布。这是通过用一组粒子表示每个\(\pi^{(k)}\)来实现的，每个粒子都有一个重要性权重，反映它对目标分布的贡献。考虑一个由隐藏状态\(X = (X_1, \ldots, X_n)\)和观测值\(Y = (Y_1, \ldots, Y_n)\)描述的隐藏马尔可夫模型。感兴趣的后验分布是\(p(X_n | Y_n)\)，它可以递归分解为\[p(X_n | Y_n) = \frac{p(X_{n-1}, Y_{n-1}) f(X_n | X_{n-1}) g(Y_n | X_n)}{p(Y_n)},\]，其中\(f(X_n | X_{n-1})\)表示状态转移密度，\(g(Y_n | X_n)\)表示在给定状态\(X_n\)时观测到\(Y_n\)的可能性。 直接从 \(p(X_n | Y_n)\) 抽样通常是不可行的，因为它太复杂了，所以 SMC 方法通过从一系列中间分布中依次抽样来解决这个问题，这些中间分布连接了先验和后验。Sequential Monte Carlo extends the principles of MCMC to dynamical systems where the target distribution evolves over time, making them particularly suitable for state-space models. The objective of SMC is to estimate a sequence of posterior distributions \(\{ \pi^{(k)} \}\) that progressively approximate the target distribution. This is achieved by representing each \(\pi^{(k)}\) with a set of particles, each assigned an importance weight that reflects its contribution to the target distribution. Consider a hidden Markov model characterized by hidden states \(X = (X_1, \ldots, X_n)\) and observations \(Y = (Y_1, \ldots, Y_n)\). The posterior distribution of interest is \(p(X_n | Y_n)\), which can be decomposed recursively as \[p(X_n | Y_n) = \frac{p(X_{n-1}, Y_{n-1}) f(X_n | X_{n-1}) g(Y_n | X_n)}{p(Y_n)},\] where \(f(X_n | X_{n-1})\) denotes the state transition density, and \(g(Y_n | X_n)\) represents the likelihood of observing \(Y_n\) given the state \(X_n\). Direct sampling from \(p(X_n | Y_n)\) is typically infeasible due to its complexity, so SMC methods approach this challenge by sequentially sampling from a series of intermediate distributions that bridge the gap between the prior and the posterior.

在实际实现中，SMC 使用重要性采样，从提议分布 \(q(X_n | Y_n)\) 中抽取粒子 \(X_n^{(i)}\)。每个粒子被赋予一个重要性权重 \(w_n^{(i)}\)，计算方式为In practice, SMC employs importance sampling, where particles \(X_n^{(i)}\) are drawn from a proposal distribution \(q(X_n | Y_n)\). Each particle is assigned an importance weight \(w_n^{(i)}\), calculated as

\[w_n^{(i)} = \frac{p(Y_n | X_n^{(i)}) p(X_n^{(i)})}{q(X_n^{(i)} | Y_n)}.\] 然后后验分布被近似为围绕粒子的δ函数的加权和\(\delta\)：\[\hat{p}_N(dX_n | Y_n) = \frac{1}{N} \sum_{i=1}^N W_n^{(i)} \delta_{X_n^{(i)}}(dX_n),\] 其中 \(W_n^{(i)}\) 是归一化权重。不过，SMC中一个常见问题是权重退化，少数粒子可能会主导权重分布，导致粒子多样性的丧失。为了解决这个问题，会加入重采样步骤，生成一组等权重的新粒子，从而维持粒子群的多样性和代表性。\[w_n^{(i)} = \frac{p(Y_n | X_n^{(i)}) p(X_n^{(i)})}{q(X_n^{(i)} | Y_n)}.\] The posterior distribution is then approximated by a weighted sum of delta functions \(\delta\) centered at the particles: \[\hat{p}_N(dX_n | Y_n) = \frac{1}{N} \sum_{i=1}^N W_n^{(i)} \delta_{X_n^{(i)}}(dX_n),\] where \(W_n^{(i)}\) are the normalized weights. However, a common issue in SMC is weight degeneracy, where a few particles may dominate the weight distribution, leading to a loss of diversity among particles. To address this, resampling steps are incorporated to generate a new set of equally weighted particles, thereby maintaining the diversity and representativeness of the particle population.

重要性抽样也是一种通用的方差缩减技术，我们将在第 2.6 节再次讨论它Importance sampling is also a general variance reduction technique and will be revisited again in Section 2.6

离散事件仿真 Discrete-Event Simulation

在定义离散事件系统或模型之前，我们先简单总结一下离散时间系统，在这种系统中，系统的状态会在固定的时间点上发生变化，通常是在系统建模者预先指定的均匀确定间隔内。例如，通过常微分方程驱动的系统模拟通常就是这种方式。相比之下，在离散事件系统中，系统的状态只有在系统中发生某个事件时才会改变。典型的例子包括排队系统和库存系统，这些事件可能包括到达、服务完成、离开、需求到达以及订单的生成和到货。在排队系统中，系统状态会随着到达而增加，随着离开而减少。Before defining discrete-event systems or models, we briefly summarize discrete-time systems, where the state of the system changes at fixed time points, usually at evenly spaced deterministic intervals specified in advance by the system modeler. For example, the simulation of a system driven by ordinary differential equations is generally carried out in this manner. In contrast, in a discrete-event system, the state of the system doesn’t change until an event in the system occurs. Typical examples include queueing and inventory systems, where events include arrivals, service completions, departures, demand arrivals, and order placements and arrivals. In a queueing system, the state of the system would increase with arrivals and decrease with departures.

离散事件仿真是指对离散事件系统模型进行仿真，这种模型的特点是通过下一个事件机制来推进仿真时钟（时间），并且在大多数DES软件中都会使用。仿真过程中会维护一个事件列表日程，这个日程驱动着系统状态的动态变化。在仿真的每一步中，列表上的下一个事件会推进仿真时钟时间，并相应更新状态变量和事件列表日程。Discrete-event simulation refers to the simulation of a discrete-event system model, which is characterized by the next-event mechanism for advancing the simulation clock (time) and used in most DES software. The simulation keeps a running event list schedule, which drives the dynamics of the system state. In each step of the simulation, the next event on the list advances the simulation clock time and updates the state variables and the event list schedule accordingly.

例如，考虑最简单的离散事件系统之一：单服务台排队系统。顾客逐个到达，若系统正忙则先排队等候，随后接受服务，并在服务完成后离开，如图 2.1 所示。To illustrate, consider perhaps the simplest discrete-event system: a single-server queue, where customers arrive (one at a time), are served after possibly queueing if the system is already busy, and then leave upon service completion, as depicted in Figure 2.1.

在这种情况下，会有两种主要类型的事件：到达和离开（或服务完成），其中后一种只有在系统忙碌时才可能发生。In this case, there would be two main types of events: an arrival and a departure (or service completion), where the latter only possible when the system is busy.

在任何时候，事件列表日程最多包含三种可能的事件：到达、服务完成（离开）以及模拟结束（这可能是固定时间，也可能由到达或服务事件决定，例如完成一定数量的服务）。如果系统状态是系统中的客户数量，那么在到达事件（记作 \(E_i\)）发生时状态增加一，而在服务完成或离开事件（记作 \(D_i\)）发生时状态减少一。图 2.2 展示了队列的一个可能的示例路径或实现，其中状态是系统中的客户数量，并且系统从空状态开始。The event list schedule at any time would comprise at most three possible events: arrival, service completion (departure), and end of simulation (which could be a fixed time or a time governed by an arrival or service event, e.g., the completion of a certain number of services). If the system state is the number of customers in the system, then the state increases by one with an arrival event denoted by \(E_i\) and decreases by one with a service completion or departure event denoted by \(D_i\). Figure 2.2 illustrates a possible sample path or realization for the queue, where the state is the number of system, and the system starts empty.

对于排队系统，通常关注的输出包括利用率（服务器或系统忙碌的时间比例）、排队延迟、整个系统时间（也称为周期时间和流动时间）、排队人数以及系统内的人数。性能指标包括均值、中位数、方差、概率、分位数以及其他从输出过程中得出的统计数据。这些指标可以针对离散的客户集合计算（比如平均延迟或平均等待时间），也可以针对连续时间计算（比如系统平均人数或利用率）。For queueing systems, typical outputs of interest include utilization (fraction of time the server or system is busy), delay in queue, total system time (also known as cycle time and flow time), number in queue, and number in system. Performance metrics include mean, median, variance, probabilities, quantiles, and other statistics derived from the output processes. These can be computed over a discrete set of the customers (e.g., average delay or mean delay) or over continuous time (e.g., average number in system or utilization).

基于智能体的仿真 Agent-Based Simulation

智能体是一种自主“实体”，能够感知其环境，包括其他智能体，并利用这些信息做出决策。智能体具有属性和一套基本的如果/那么规则来控制它们的行为。它们也可能学习（提升对其他智能体和环境的理解）并随着时间调整自己的行为（修改决策规则），这需要某种形式的记忆。智能体的例子包括人、动物、车辆和组织。在基于智能体的模型（ABS）中，关键特征是这些实体（智能体）与其他实体及其环境的显著互动。An agent is an autonomous “entity” capable of sensing its environment, including other agents, and using this information to make decisions. Agents possess attributes and a set of basic if/then rules that govern their behaviors. They may also learn (improve their understanding of other agents and the environment) and adapt their behaviors (modify their decision rules) over time, requiring some form of memory. Examples of agents include people, animals, vehicles, and organizations. The key characteristic in an ABS is the interactions of the entities (agents) significantly with other entities and with their environment.

因此，ABS模型侧重于个体主体的行为和相互作用，而DES模型则从系统层面来观察。复杂的ABS模型通常使用面向对象的软件（例如Java）来实现，其中实例变量对应属性，方法对应行为。虽然原则上ABS模型可以使用商业DES软件包来实现，但这可能不是最自然和用户友好的平台。专门用于进行ABS的仿真软件包或工具包通常需要面向对象编程，通常用Java来建模主体行为的多样性和复杂性。ABS平台如AnyLogic、MASON、NetLogo和Repast Simphony提供了强大的工具来建模复杂系统。 ABS 已经被应用到各个领域，包括国防、经济学、流行病学、游戏、国土安全、物流、制造业、电影、交通、社会科学以及供应链。Thus, ABS models focus on the behavior and interaction of individual agents, whereas DES models take a system-level view. Complex ABS models are typically implemented using object-oriented software (e.g., Java), where instance variables correspond to attributes and methods correspond to behaviors. While in principle ABS models can be implemented using commercial DES software packages, it may not be the most natural and user-friendly platform. Simulation packages or toolkits specifically designed for performing ABS generally require object-oriented programming, usually in Java, which can be used to model the diversity and complexity of agent behaviors. ABS platforms such as AnyLogic, MASON, NetLogo, and Repast Simphony offer robust tools for modeling complex systems. ABS has been applied to various fields, including defense, economics, epidemiology, games, homeland security, logistics, manufacturing, movies, transportation, social sciences, and supply chains.

物流管理扩展示例 Extended Example from Logistics Management

我们用一个仓库管理的例子来说明DES和ABS。We illustrate DES and ABS using a warehouse management example.

仓库运营通过对每个事件进行动态模拟分析，并生成全面的绩效报告。在随机仓库管理系统中，货物系统地摆放在货架上，而订单则随机到达，这体现了物流操作的固有不确定性。为了应对对高效物流日益增长的需求，自动引导车（AGV）已广泛部署在智能仓库中，作为主要运输方式。然而，由于订单量大和空间有限限制了AGV的移动，优化AGV的效率仍然面临重大挑战。 AGV（自动导引车）操作的优化主要涉及两个方面：调度，即在可用资源的范围内分配订单给AGV；以及路径规划，即确定AGV完成运输请求的最有效行驶路线。传统上，这两个问题是分开研究的；不过，最近的研究越来越多地采用了将调度和路径规划结合起来的综合方法，以提升整体系统性能。这些仿真模型的结构配置和输入参数在设计和优化AGV的调度与路径算法时起着关键作用，从而影响仓库操作的整体效率和响应速度。Warehouse operations are analyzed by simulating dynamics on an event-by-event basis and generating comprehensive performance reports. In stochastic warehouse management systems, goods are systematically organized on storage racks while orders arrive randomly, embodying the inherent uncertainties of logistics operations. To address the escalating demand for efficient logistics, automated guided vehicles (AGVs) have been extensively deployed in intelligent warehouses as the primary mode of transportation. However, optimizing the efficiency of AGVs presents significant challenges due to high order volumes and limited spatial constraints that restrict AGV movement. The optimization of AGV operations encompasses two primary issues: scheduling, which involves the allocation of orders to AGVs within the bounds of available resources, and routing, which entails determining the most effective travel paths for AGVs to fulfill transportation requests. Traditionally, these two problems were investigated independently; however, recent studies have increasingly adopted integrated approaches that simultaneously address scheduling and routing to enhance overall system performance. The structural configuration and input parameters of these simulation models play a crucial role in the design and effectiveness of scheduling and routing algorithms for AGVs, thereby influencing the overall efficiency and responsiveness of the warehouse operations.

在考虑将AGV作为自主智能体在仿真环境中建模时，这个DES框架本质上与ABS有关。在ABS方法中，每个AGV都被视为一个独立的代理，具备自身的决策能力、行为，以及与其他代理和环境的互动。这种以代理为中心的视角可以更动态、更自适应地优化调度和路径规划过程。例如，AGV代理可以自主协商路径以避免碰撞，适应实时订单量的变化，并根据本地信息和预设规则协作优化任务。通过将AGV建模为代理，仿真能够捕捉到由单个AGV自主行为产生的涌现行为和复杂互动，从而实现更真实、更高效的仓库运营模拟。 此外，ABS 还便于引入学习算法，使 AGV 代理能够通过经验不断提升性能。这增强了系统应对变化和突发情况的能力，从而提高了仓库运营的整体韧性和效率。因此，将 ABS 与 DES 方法结合，可以提供一个更全面、更灵活的框架来建模和优化 AGV 运行，大大提升了模拟反映现实物流环境中细微变化和适应能力的能力。This DES framework is intrinsically related to ABS when considering the modeling of AGVs as autonomous agents within the simulation environment. In an ABS approach, each AGV is represented as an independent agent endowed with its own decision-making capabilities, behaviors, and interactions with other agents and the environment. This agent-centric perspective allows for more dynamic and adaptive optimization of both scheduling and routing processes. For instance, AGV agents can autonomously negotiate paths to avoid collisions, adapt to real-time changes in order volumes, and collaboratively optimize their tasks based on local information and predefined rules. By modeling AGVs as agents, the simulation can capture emergent behaviors and complex interactions that arise from the autonomous actions of individual AGVs, leading to more realistic and efficient warehouse operation simulations. Furthermore, ABS facilitates the incorporation of learning algorithms, enabling AGV agents to improve their performance over time through experience. This enhances the system’s ability to handle variability and unforeseen disruptions, thereby increasing the overall resilience and efficiency of warehouse operations. Consequently, integrating ABS with DES methodologies provides a more comprehensive and flexible framework for modeling and optimizing AGV operations, significantly enhancing the simulation’s capacity to reflect the nuanced and adaptive nature of real-world logistics environments.

在实际操作中，订单会随机且独立地到达仓库管理系统，每个订单都指定了特定的拣货架和AGV的送货位置。这些订单的到达过程必须进行建模，以捕捉订单流入的随机特性。AGV的交通网络通常以网格形式表示，由可通行的方形单元组成，每个单元保持一致的大小和形状。图2.3展示了AGV交通网络的网格化表示——即在模拟仓库环境中AGV的空间布局和移动路径。这个基于网格的框架有助于仓库布局和AGV移动的图形化可视化与模拟，确保操作系统化且高效。在这个网格中，每个方格一次只能容纳一个AGV，从而防止拥堵和碰撞。 特定的方格被指定为AGV在分配订单前的停车位、AGV取货的货架位置，以及派送货物的交付地点。此外，一些方格被标记为阻塞或保留，表示由于障碍物或不可移动的结构，AGV无法进入，从而增强了仿真的真实感和准确性。AGV通过在相邻方格之间进行水平和垂直移动来在网格中导航，每个方格只允许一个AGV占用。In practice, orders arrive randomly and independently at the warehouse management system, each specifying a particular picking rack and a delivery location for AGVs. The arrival process of these orders must be modeled to capture the stochastic nature of order inflow. The AGV traffic network is frequently represented as a grid comprising traversable square units, each maintaining consistent size and shape. Figure 2.3 illustrates the grid-based representation of an AGV traffic network – the spatial organization and movement pathways of AGVs within the simulated warehouse environment. This grid-based framework facilitates the graphical visualization and simulation of warehouse layouts and AGV movements, ensuring systematic and efficient operations. Within this grid, each square unit accommodates only one AGV at a time, thereby preventing congestion and collisions. Specific squares are designated as berths for AGV parking prior to order assignment, picking racks where AGVs collect goods, and delivery locations where goods are dispatched to fulfill orders. Additionally, certain squares are marked as obstructed or reserved to denote areas inaccessible to AGVs due to obstacles or immovable structures, thereby enhancing the realism and accuracy of the simulation. AGVs navigate the grid by executing horizontal and vertical movements between adjacent square units, adhering to the constraints of single occupancy per square.

底层的仿真模型通过订单的随机到达引入了固有的随机性，并使用了不同的模块来进行调度和路径规划。调度模块负责将到达的订单分配给可用的AGV，而路径规划模块则确定AGV在网格网络中移动的最佳路线。假设所有AGV的功能是均一的，每辆AGV的电池容量都足够处理所有分配的订单，无需在操作过程中充电或更换电池，因为AGV可以在指定停靠点进行充电或换电。这一假设通过消除与电池管理和AGV途中可能故障相关的复杂性，从而简化了模型。每辆AGV都以恒定速度运行，装载和卸载时间固定。 因此，AGV在任何时候都可能处于四种状态之一：(1) 拣货状态，移动到拣货架；(2) 交付状态，移动到交付地点；(3) 停放状态，卸货后等待新的任务；以及(4) 空闲状态，停在泊位上，有或没有新订单。AGV移动的关键要素如图2.5所示。The underlying simulation model incorporates inherent randomness through the stochastic arrival of orders and employs distinct modules for scheduling and routing. The scheduling module is responsible for assigning incoming orders to available AGVs, while the routing module determines the optimal travel paths for AGV movement within the grid network. The AGVs are assumed to be homogeneous in function, with each AGV possessing sufficient battery capacity to handle all assigned orders without necessitating recharging or battery replacement during operation, as AGVs can be recharged or swapped at designated berths. This assumption simplifies the model by eliminating complexities associated with battery management and potential AGV breakdowns during transit. Each AGV operates at a constant speed, with fixed loading and unloading durations. Consequently, an AGV can exist in one of four states at any given time: (1) picking state, moving to a picking rack; (2) delivering state, moving to a delivery location; (3) parking state, awaiting new assignments post-unloading; and (4) idle state, stationed at the berth with or without new orders. The key elements of the AGV movement are illustrated in Figure 2.5.

在仿真模型中，AGV调度模块在接收到订单或AGV切换到停车状态时被触发。每次调度调用时，会识别可用订单集合和活动AGV集合。调度优化问题是确定性的，决策变量表示订单分配给AGV的情况。调度完成后，AGV路径规划模块会在装卸过程后启动。该模块包含部分路径请求子模块，将完整路径分割为固定长度的部分路径，确保无碰撞导航。只有当请求的部分路径未被占用时，AGV才会移动，优先级根据请求时间确定。整个系统的目标是设计高效的调度和路径规划策略，以最小化调整后的平均订单周期时间。In the simulation model, the AGV scheduling module is triggered upon receiving an order or when an AGV transitions to a parking state. At each scheduling invocation, the set of available orders and the set of active AGVs are identified. The scheduling optimization problem is deterministic, with decision variables indicating the assignment of order to AGV. Following scheduling, the AGV routing module is activated after loading and unloading processes. This module comprises partial route request submodules that segment the full path into fixed-length partial routes, ensuring collision-free navigation. AGVs move only if the requested partial routes are unoccupied, with priority given based on request time. The overall system objective is to design efficient scheduling and routing policies to minimize an adjusted average order cycle time.

这个框架的一个自然延伸是直接使用世界模型来支持AGV的调度和路径决策。在这种情况下，世界模型充当了仓库环境的结构化数字表示，不仅编码了交通网络的几何布局，还包括系统的操作语义，比如工作站位置、物料缓存、交通方向、设备状态和拥堵模式。这种表示让调度模块可以在一个可用于模拟的环境中进行推理，而不是仅仅在一个抽象的图上操作。A natural extension of this framework is to use a world model to support AGV scheduling and routing decisions directly. In this setting, the world model serves as a structured digital representation of the warehouse environment, encoding not only the geometric layout of the traffic network, but also the operational semantics of the system, such as workstation locations, material buffers, traffic directions, equipment states, and congestion patterns. This representation enables the scheduling module to reason over a simulation-ready environment rather than over a purely abstract graph.

更具体地说，世界模型为AGV调度提供了统一的状态描述。它可以汇总订单到达、AGV位置、队列长度、机器状态和路径占用等实时信息，并将这些信息转换成适合下游优化或学习算法使用的形式。基于这个状态，系统可以在执行前评估不同的调度和路径选择方案，比如估算行驶时间、堵塞风险、空闲时间，以及局部拥堵对下游任务的影响。从这个角度来看，世界模型就像是物理仓库和决策层之间的接口，使得AGV调度可以在预测、模拟和反馈的闭环中进行。More specifically, the world model provides a unified state description for AGV dispatching. It can aggregate real-time information on order arrivals, AGV locations, queue lengths, machine status, and path occupancy, and map them into a form suitable for downstream optimization or learning algorithms. Based on this state, the system can evaluate alternative dispatching and routing decisions before execution, for example by estimating travel times, blocking risk, idle time, and the impact of local congestion on downstream tasks. In this sense, the world model acts as an interface between the physical warehouse and the decision layer, allowing AGV scheduling to be performed in a closed loop with prediction, simulation, and feedback.

从仿真和优化的角度来看，这种能力尤其有价值，因为AGV的控制本质上是动态的且具有空间耦合性。基于世界模型的方法可以将订单流程的离散事件仿真、AGV交互的基于智能体的建模，以及调度和路径规划的优化或强化学习结合起来。因此，系统可以超越静态的最短路径规划，而是支持前瞻性的调度策略，考虑未来的拥堵、资源竞争和不断变化的操作优先级。From the perspective of simulation and optimization, this capability is particularly valuable because AGV control is inherently dynamic and spatially coupled. A world-model-based approach makes it possible to combine discrete-event simulation for order flows, agent-based modeling for AGV interactions, and optimization or reinforcement learning for dispatching and routing. As a result, the system can move beyond static shortest-path planning and instead support anticipative scheduling policies that account for future congestion, resource contention, and changing operational priorities.

蒙特卡洛方法与仿真的进展 Advances in MC Methods and Simulation

最近，MC 模拟的进展主要集中在通过整合高性能计算和并行处理技术来提升其可扩展性，并将其应用于日益复杂的系统中。MCMC 和 SMC 方法是计算统计中广泛使用的技术，特别擅长近似那些无法直接采样的复杂概率分布。MCMC 方法利用构建一个马尔可夫链，其平衡分布对应目标分布，从而方便在贝叶斯推断和各种其他统计应用中经常遇到的高维空间中进行采样。Recent advances in MC simulation have focused on enhancing its scalability and applicability to increasingly complex systems through the integration of high-performance computing and parallel processing techniques. MCMC and SMC methods are widely used techniques in computational statistics particularly adept at approximating complex probability distributions that are otherwise intractable to sample directly. MCMC methods leverage the construction of a Markov chain whose equilibrium distribution corresponds to the target distribution, facilitating sampling in high-dimensional spaces commonly encountered in Bayesian inference and various other statistical applications.

此外，人们也开发了自适应蒙特卡洛方法，这些方法可以根据不断变化的模拟状态动态调整采样策略，从而进一步提高效率和准确性。机器学习还促成了替代模型的创建，这些模型能够在显著降低计算成本的同时，近似复杂的模拟输出，从而使大规模系统的优化和分析更加高效。Additionally, adaptive MC methods that dynamically adjust sampling strategies based on the evolving simulation state have been developed to further improve efficiency and accuracy. ML has also fostered the creation of surrogate models that approximate complex simulation outputs with significantly reduced computational costs, thereby facilitating more efficient optimization and analysis of large-scale systems.

2.2 离散随机优化2.2 Discrete Stochastic Optimization

通过随机仿真进行的离散优化主要侧重于寻找变量的最佳设置，这些变量的取值来自一个可数的集合，可以是有序的也可以是分类的。有序变量可以取整数或离散值，这些值的顺序有实际意义。分类变量则涵盖了更广泛的离散决策，从二元（例如开-关或0-1）变量到更抽象的选择，比如从有限集合中选择一系列动作。虽然有序变量可以用二元变量来逻辑表示，但当顺序具有实际意义时保留顺序通常是合理的，因为当备选方案数量很多时，这样可以进行更高效的搜索。Discrete optimization via stochastic simulation focuses on finding the best settings for variables that take on values from a countable set, either ordered or categorical. Ordered variables can assume integer or discrete values, where the order of these values has a physical meaning. Categorical variables encompass a broader range of discrete decisions, from binary (e.g., on-off or 0-1) variables to more abstract choices, such as selecting a sequence of actions from a finite set. While ordered variables can be logically represented using binary variables, retaining their order generally makes sense when the order has physical meaning, as it can lead to more efficient search procedures when there are a large number of alternatives.

在这一部分，我们重点讨论在有限情景下寻找最优方案，这种情况下备选方案的数量少且固定；因此，优化中不存在“搜索”过程，最优解可以通过简单地排列给定的备选方案来找到。挑战在于目标函数存在噪声，即每个备选方案的表现只能通过抽样来估算；因此，最终“优化”问题中的“决策变量”涉及如何在各备选方案之间分配抽样预算。在仿真环境中，这意味着需要决定下一个仿真哪个备选方案，也就是如何分配仿真重复次数。本节只关注在备选方案中找到最优方案。其他未考虑的目标包括选择可能包含最优方案的子集、提供备选方案的完整排序，以及将每个备选方案与已知标准或控制进行比较。 注意，在排序与选择中，“最好”是指最小的均值（想想成本），但在多臂老虎机的设置中是指最大的均值（奖励）。In this section, we focus on finding the best in the finite setting where the number of alternatives is small and fixed; hence, there is no “search” process in the optimization, and the optimum is found by simply ordering the given alternatives. The challenge is that the objective function is noisy, i.e., the performance of each alternative can only be estimated by sampling; thus, the “decision variables” in the resulting “optimization” problem relate to determining how to allocate a sampling budget among the alternatives. In the simulation context, this translates to deciding which alternatives to simulate next, i.e., how to allocate simulation replications. This section only considers finding the best among the alternatives. Other objectives not considered here include selecting a subset that is likely to contain the best, providing a complete ordering of the alternatives, and comparing each alternative to a known standard or control. Note that “best” will be minimum mean (think of costs) for ranking and selection but maximum mean (rewards) in the multi-armed bandit setting.

统计排序与选择（R&S） Statistical Ranking and Selection (R&S)

我们考虑经典的R&S问题，即从一组均值未知的有限备选方案 \((\mu _1, \ldots ,{\mu _k})\) 中选出最佳方案，这里的“最佳”是指均值最小的方案，整个过程中用 \(*\) 表示，即 \(\mu_* \leq \mu\)。在仿真环境下，每个备选方案通常代表一个复杂的随机模型（例如排队网络），因此随机输出的均值（例如系统平均时间）无法通过分析方法确定，但可以通过仿真进行估计。We consider the classical R&S problem of selecting the best alternative from a finite set of alternatives with unknown means \((\mu _1, \ldots ,{\mu _k})\), where best here will be the alternative with the smallest mean, to be denoted throughout by \(*\), i.e., \(\mu_* \leq \mu\). In the simulation context, each alternative typically represents a complex stochastic model (e.g., a queueing network), so the mean of the random output (e.g., average system time) cannot be determined analytically but can be estimated via simulation.

一个R&S（排序与选择）程序通常包括两个阶段：抽样和选择。在抽样阶段，会对各个备选方案进行抽样（进行仿真重复以估计输出性能），直到满足某个停止条件。一旦抽样结束（所有仿真重复完成），就会选择一个系统作为最佳。正确选择概率（PCS）是指所选方案对应*的概率。例如，如果用\(\bar{X}_i\)表示的样本均值来选择最佳方案，那么PCS就是\[{\rm{PCS}} = \mathbb{P}(\bar{X}_* \leq \bar{X}_i ~\forall i).\]的联合概率。A R&S procedure generally consists of two phases: sampling and selection. In the sampling phase, the alternatives are sampled (simulation replications conducted to estimate output performance) until some stopping condition is satisfied. Once the sampling has concluded (all the simulation replications finished), then a single system is selected to be declared the best. The probability of correct selection (PCS) is the probability that the selected alternative corresponds to *. For example, if the sample means denoted by \(\bar{X}_i\) are used to select the best, then PCS is given by the joint probability \[{\rm{PCS}} = \mathbb{P}(\bar{X}_* \leq \bar{X}_i ~\forall i).\]

假设通过服从联合分布 \(({X_{1,\ell }}, \ldots ,{X_{k,\ell }}) \sim Q( \cdot ;\theta )\) 的独立随机样本（仿真重复）估计各候选方案的未知均值，其中 \(\ell \in \mathbb{Z}^+\)，而 \(\theta\) 包含采样分布的所有未知参数，包括 \({\mu _1}, \ldots ,{\mu _k}\) 和标准差 \({\sigma _1}, \ldots, {\sigma _k}\)。The unknown means of the alternatives are assumed to be estimated using independent random samples (simulation replications) following a joint distribution, \(({X_{1,\ell }}, \ldots ,{X_{k,\ell }}) \sim Q( \cdot ;\theta )\), where \(\ell \in \mathbb{Z}^+\) and \(\theta\) includes all unknown parameters of the sampling distribution, including \({\mu _1}, \ldots ,{\mu _k}\) and the standard deviations \({\sigma _1}, \ldots, {\sigma _k}\).

R&S 文献中一个常见的假设是，不同备选方案（即 \({X_{i,\ell }},{X_{j,\ell }}\) 对 \(i \ne j\)）的样本服从独立的正态分布。实际上，随机模型的输出通常是许多随机变量的平均值（例如，被服务客户的平均系统时间），这可以通过中心极限定理（CLT）来证明正态性假设。如果样本不是正态分布，可以使用批处理来实现近似正态分布。根据大数定律（LLN），样本均值几乎必然收敛到真实均值，即 \(\bar{X}_i(n) := \frac{1}{n}\sum\limits_{\ell = 1}^n {{X_{i,\ell }}} \to {\mu _i}\) a.s. \(n \to \infty\)，对于 \(i = 1, \ldots ,k\)。因此，在无限的模拟预算下，最终可以选择出最佳备选方案。然而，仿真重复通常成本高昂，在实际中往往导致模拟预算非常有限。A common assumption in the R&S literature is that samples from different alternatives (i.e., \({X_{i,\ell }},{X_{j,\ell }}\) for \(i \ne j\)) follow independent normal distributions. In practice, the output of a stochastic model is often the average of many random variables (e.g., average system time of customers served), justifying the normality assumption by a CLT. If the samples are not normally distributed, batching can be used to achieve approximate normality. By the LLN, sample means converge to the true means almost surely (a.s.), i.e., \(\bar{X}_i(n) := \frac{1}{n}\sum\limits_{\ell = 1}^n {{X_{i,\ell }}} \to {\mu _i}\) a.s. \(n \to \infty\), for \(i = 1, \ldots ,k\). Thus, with an infinite simulation budget, the best alternative could eventually be selected. However, simulation replications are typically costly, often resulting in a very limited simulation budget in practice.

传统的R&S方法会对PCS或其他类似指标提供统计上的保证，通常遵循无差异带（indifference-zone）公式，该公式指定了无差异带参数\(\Delta\)，并规定对于任何次优方案\(k \ne {*}\)，\[\begin{equation*} {\mu _{{*}}} - {\mu _k} \ge \Delta. \end{equation*}\]基于无差异带公式的程序能够在最坏情况下保证PCS，这种最坏情况通常称为滑移配置（slippage configuration），这通常会导致保守的分配，从而比典型问题需要更多的仿真重复次数。具体来说，这些程序会将采样（仿真重复）分配基本上按每个方案的（估计）方差成比例分配。换句话说，下列伪优化问题的最优解是：Traditional R&S approaches provide a statistical guarantee on PCS or other similar measures, often following the indifference-zone formulation, which specifies an indifference zone parameters \(\Delta\) and stipulates that for any suboptimal alternative \(k \ne {*}\), \[\begin{equation*} {\mu _{{*}}} - {\mu _k} \ge \Delta. \end{equation*}\] Procedures derived under the indifference-zone formulation guarantee PCS under the worst-case scenario, often referred to as the slippage configuration, which typically leads to conservative allocations resulting in more simulation replications than needed for typical problems. In particular, these procedures lead to an allocation of sampling (simulation replications) that is basically proportional to the (estimated) variance of each alternative. In other words, the optimal solution to the following pseudo-optimization problem:

\[\begin{equation*} \min _{\{ {n_k, k = 1,\ldots, K }\}} L(n_1,\ldots,n_K) {\text{~subject to~}} {\rm{PCS}} \geq 1 - \alpha, \end{equation*}\]

其中，\(n_i\) 表示分配给方案 \(i\) 的仿真重复次数，\(L\) 表示分配量的某个线性“损失”函数，例如求和；\(\alpha \in [0,1]\)（例如，95%“置信”水平对应 0.05）由下式给出：\[n_i \propto \sigma^2_i.\]where \(n_i\) denotes the number of replications allocated to alternative \(i\), \(L\) denotes some linear “loss” function on the allocations, e.g., the sum, and \(\alpha \in [0,1]\), e.g., 0.05 for a 95% “confidence” level, is given by \[n_i \propto \sigma^2_i.\]

在算法上，R&S 程序是分阶段实现的，阶段数从两阶段到完全顺序不等。在两阶段程序中，第一阶段用作“试点”运行，用于估计计算第二阶段实际分配所需的参数。这样程序的通用版本通常在第一阶段对每个 \(K\) 个备选项采集 \(n_0\) 个样本，以计算（例如使用样本均值和方差等统计量）理论上最优的 \(n_i\) 来分配每个备选项的总样本量 \(i\)，然后在第二阶段采集 \((n_i-n_0)^+\) 个样本，其中 \(x^+ \equiv \max(x,0)\) 表示参数的非负部分。另一方面，完全顺序程序则一次分配一个仿真重复，这可以基于“全局”或“局部”信息，通常后者会导致某种类型的“贪心”算法。 不过，即使这些方法通常也会从初始化阶段开始，例如，每个\(K\)选项使用\(n_0\)个样本。Algorithmically, R&S procedures are implemented in stages that range from two stages to fully sequential. In a two-stage procedure, the first stage is used as a “pilot” run for estimating parameters used to compute the final allocation that is realized in the second stage. A generic version of such a procedure would generally take \(n_0\) samples for each of the \(K\) alternatives in the first stage to calculate (e.g., using statistics such as the sample means and variances) a theoretically optimal \(n_i\) for the total allocation for each alternative \(i\), and then sample \((n_i-n_0)^+\) samples in the second stage, where \(x^+ \equiv \max(x,0)\) denotes the nonnegative part of the argument. On the other hand, a fully sequential procedure would allocation one simulation replication at a time, which could be based on “global” or “local” information, where the latter usually leads to some type of “greedy” algorithm; however, even these methods often begin with an initialization phase, e.g., with \(n_0\) samples for each of the \(K\) alternatives.

图 2.6 展示了一个有五个备选方案的例子，其中显示了每个备选方案基于 \(n_0\) 次初始重复的均值对应的风格化箱线图。基于估计的不确定性进行进一步采样会将更多的重复分配给备选方案 \(1\)、\(4\) 和 \(5\)，以确保在前面描述的最坏情况下达到 PCS 级别。Figure 2.6 presents an example with five alternatives, where shown are the corresponding stylized box plots for the means based on \(n_0\) initial replications for each alternative. Further sampling based on estimated uncertainty would allocate more replications to alternatives \(1\), \(4\), and \(5\), to ensure the level of PCS is achieved in the worst-case scenario described earlier.

不过，在这个例子中，看起来替代方案 \(1\)、\(4\) 和 \(5\) 不太可能比 \(2\) 和 \(3\) 更好，所以把大量额外的仿真重复分配给它们可能会浪费计算资源。For this example, however, it appears unlikely that alternatives \(1\), \(4\), and \(5\) are better than \(2\) and \(3\), so that allocating a significant number of additional simulation replications to them would be an inefficient use of computational resources.

相反，直觉可能会让人得出这样的结论：为了确定最佳（最小均值）方案，仿真重复次数应该分配给那些方差较大或均值较小的方案。基于这两个因素平衡分配就是所谓的“均值-方差”或“利用-探索”权衡。将这种权衡形式化需要指定一个度量指标来衡量采样效率，比如 PCS。Rather, intuition might lead one to conclude that for the objective of determining the best (minimum mean) alternative, simulation replications should be allocated to those alternatives with either a larger variance or smaller mean. Balancing allocations based on these two factors is what is known as the “mean-variance” or “exploitation-exploration” tradeoff. Formalizing this trade-off necessitates specifying a metric to measure sampling efficiency, e.g., PCS.

因此，在所有可能的情况下保证 PCS 水平的另一种方法是考虑在计算预算限制下最大化 PCS，这个方法接下来会讲。Thus, an alternative approach to guaranteeing a PCS level under all possible scenarios is to consider maximizing the PCS under a computing budget constraint, which is taken up next.

最优计算预算分配（OCBA） Optimal Computing Budget Allocation (OCBA)

最优计算预算分配（OCBA）提出如下优化问题：将固定的总仿真重复次数 \(N\) 分配给 \(K\) 个候选方案，使正确选择概率（PCS）最大化：Optimal Computing Budget Allocation (OCBA) formulates the following optimization problem, with an objective of maximizing PCS by allocating a fixed total number of simulation replications \(N\) across \(K\) alternatives:

\[\begin{equation*} \max _{\{ {n_k, k = 1,\ldots, K }\}} \quad {\rm{PCS}}\quad {\text{subject to}}\quad \sum\limits_{k = 1}^K {{n_k}} = N, \end{equation*}\] 其中，\({n_k}\) 是分配给方案 \(k\) 的仿真重复次数。在总预算的渐近极限下，即当 \(N \rightarrow \infty\) 时，可以推导出以下 OCBA 采样比例 \({r_k}:=\lim_{N \rightarrow \infty} n_k/N\)：\[\begin{equation*} \max _{\{ {n_k, k = 1,\ldots, K }\}} \quad {\rm{PCS}}\quad {\text{subject to}}\quad \sum\limits_{k = 1}^K {{n_k}} = N, \end{equation*}\] where \({n_k}\) is the number of replications allocated to alternative \(k\). Under the asymptotic limit on the total budget, i.e., as \(N \rightarrow \infty\), the following OCBA sampling ratios \({r_k}:=\lim_{N \rightarrow \infty} n_k/N\) are derived:

\[\begin{equation} \frac{r_i}{r_j} = \frac{\sigma^2_i/\delta^2_i}{\sigma^2_j/\delta^2_j},~\forall i, j \neq *,~~ ~\left( \frac{r_*}{\sigma_*} \right)^2 = \sum_{i \neq *} \left( \frac{r_i}{\sigma_i} \right)^2, ~ \delta_i := \mu_i - \mu_*, \end{equation}\]

一种具有以下直观特性的分配：an allocation that has the following intuitive properties:

  • 与方差成正比，除了最好的；proportional to variance, except for the best;

  • 与距离最佳的平方差成反比，但最好之外的情况除外；inversely proportion to the squared difference from the best, again except for the best;

  • 除非它的方差非常小，否则越接近最佳越好。more to the best unless its variance is very small.

根据式（2.3）规定的分配方式，可以设计序贯仿真采样程序：先通过初始估计阶段估计均值和方差，再以两个或多个阶段实施，或者采用完全序贯的方式。The allocation prescribed by (2.3) can be used to propose sequential simulation sampling procedures that can be implemented in two or more phases or fully sequentially following an initial estimation phase to estimate the means and variances.

回到图 2.6 中显示的例子，如果目标是有效地找到最优解，替代方案 2 和 3 的分配会更高，这也符合直觉。Returning to the example shown in Figure 2.6, the allocations would be higher for alternatives 2 and 3, matching intuition if the goal is to efficiently find the best.

OCBA 的一个关键元素是它如何处理探索-利用的权衡，这在传统的 R&S 流程中没有体现，但在基于多臂老虎机模型的流程中会被明确考虑，稍后会介绍。不过，把 OCBA 融入实际算法流程本质上是启发式的，因为其主要理论基础是渐近性质的，而且分配是基于未知参数的，包括均值本身。An essential element of OCBA is the way it captures the exploration-exploitation trade-off, which is not reflected in traditional R&S procedures, but is also explicitly considered in procedures based on multi-armed bandit models to be described shortly. However, incorporating OCBA into an actual algorithmic procedure is heuristic in nature, due to the asymptotic nature of the main theoretical basis, as the allocations are based on unknown parameters, including the means themselves.

为了量化参数的不确定性，我们现在用 \(\theta\) 来表示它，假设 \(\theta\) 服从一个先验分布 \(F( \cdot ;{\zeta _0})\)，这个分布反映了我们对未知参数的先验知识，其中 \({\zeta _0}\) 被称为超参数。设 \({X_i}(N) = ({X_{i,1}}, \ldots ,{X_{i,{n_i}}})\) 和 \({{\cal E}_N} = \{ {\zeta _0},{X_1}(N), \ldots ,{X_K}(N)\}\)。可以使用贝叶斯定理计算后验分布和预测分布。如果先验分布是抽样分布的共轭先验，那么后验分布仍然属于与先验相同的参数族，记为 \(F(\cdot ;{\zeta_N})\)，其中 \({\zeta_N}\) 是后验超参数。在共轭先验下，信息集 \({\cal E}_N\) 完全由后验超参数决定，也就是 \({{\cal E}_N} = {\zeta _N}\)。To quantify the uncertainty of the parameter, which we will denote now by \(\theta\), suppose \(\theta\) follows a prior distribution \(F( \cdot ;{\zeta _0})\) that reflects our prior knowledge of the unknown parameter, where \({\zeta _0}\) is called a hyper-parameter. Let \({X_i}(N) = ({X_{i,1}}, \ldots ,{X_{i,{n_i}}})\) and \({{\cal E}_N} = \{ {\zeta _0},{X_1}(N), \ldots ,{X_K}(N)\}\). The posterior and predictive distributions can be calculated using Bayes rule. If the prior distribution is a conjugate prior of the sampling distribution, the posterior distribution remains in the same parametric family as the prior, denoted as \(F(\cdot ;{\zeta_N})\), where \({\zeta_N}\) is the posterior hyper-parameter. Under a conjugate prior, the information set \({\cal E}_N\) is fully determined by the posterior hyper-parameters, i.e., \({{\cal E}_N} = {\zeta _N}\).

PCS 也可以更一般地表示如下：PCS can also be expressed more generally as follows:

\[\begin{equation*} {\rm{PCS}}(\theta ) =\mathbb{P}({\mu _S} < {\mu _i},{\mkern 1mu} \forall i \ne S\mid \theta ) = \mathbb{E}[{L_{0 - 1}}({{\cal E}_N})\mid \theta ], \end{equation*}\]，其中 \(S\) 是在分配总共 \(N\) 次仿真重复后做出的选择决策，\({L_{0 - 1}}({{\cal E}_N}) = {\bf{1}}\{ S = *\}\) 是在 \(N\) 次重复后的零一损失。如前所述，对于仿真样本分配，损失只会在最后发生，也就是在分配完所有 \(N\) 次仿真重复之后。\[\begin{equation*} {\rm{PCS}}(\theta ) =\mathbb{P}({\mu _S} < {\mu _i},{\mkern 1mu} \forall i \ne S\mid \theta ) = \mathbb{E}[{L_{0 - 1}}({{\cal E}_N})\mid \theta ], \end{equation*}\] where \(S\) is the selection decision after allocating a total of \(N\) simulation replications, and \({L_{0 - 1}}({{\cal E}_N}) = {\bf{1}}\{ S = *\}\) is the zero-one loss after \(N\) replications. As mentioned previously, for simulation sample allocation, the loss occurs only at the end, after allocating all \(N\) simulation replications.

对于均值未知、方差已知的正态分布 \(N({\mu _i},\sigma _i^2)\)，其共轭先验为正态分布 \(N({\mu _{i(0)}},\sigma _{i(0)}^2)\)。\(\mu_i\) 的后验分布为正态分布 \(N(\mu_{i(N)}, \sigma_{i(N)}^2)\)，其中 \[\begin{equation*} {\mu _{i(N)}} = \sigma _{i(N)}^2\left( {\frac{{{\mu _{i(0)}}}}{{\sigma _{i(0)}^2}} + \frac{{{n_i}{{\bar X}_{i(N)}}}}{{\sigma _i^2}}} \right),\quad \sigma _{i(N)}^2 = {\left( {\frac{1}{{\sigma _{i(0)}^2}} + \frac{{{n_i}}}{{\sigma _i^2}}} \right)^{ - 1}}, \end{equation*}\]。For a normal distribution \(N({\mu _i},\sigma _i^2)\) with unknown mean and known variance, the conjugate prior is a normal distribution \(N({\mu _{i(0)}},\sigma _{i(0)}^2)\). The posterior distribution of \(\mu_i\) is the normal distribution \(N(\mu_{i(N)}, \sigma_{i(N)}^2)\), where \[\begin{equation*} {\mu _{i(N)}} = \sigma _{i(N)}^2\left( {\frac{{{\mu _{i(0)}}}}{{\sigma _{i(0)}^2}} + \frac{{{n_i}{{\bar X}_{i(N)}}}}{{\sigma _i^2}}} \right),\quad \sigma _{i(N)}^2 = {\left( {\frac{1}{{\sigma _{i(0)}^2}} + \frac{{{n_i}}}{{\sigma _i^2}}} \right)^{ - 1}}, \end{equation*}\]

而 \({X_{i,{n_i} + 1}}\) 的预测分布为 \(N({\mu _{i(N)}},\sigma _i^2 + \sigma _{i(N)}^2)\)。如果 \({\sigma _{i(0)}} \to \infty\)，则 \({\mu _{i(N)}} \approx {\bar X_{i(N)}}\)，对应无信息先验。and the predictive distribution of \({X_{i,{n_i} + 1}}\) is \(N({\mu _{i(N)}},\sigma _i^2 + \sigma _{i(N)}^2)\). If \({\sigma _{i(0)}} \to \infty\), \({\mu _{i(N)}} \approx {\bar X_{i(N)}}\), corresponding to an uninformative prior.

在仿真样本分配问题中，动态决策可以被表述为动态分配与选择（A\(\&\)S）策略。分配策略是一系列映射\({{\cal A}}( \cdot ) = ({{\cal A}_1}( \cdot ), \ldots ,{{\cal A}_t}( \cdot ))\)，它根据收集到的信息，依次将每个样本分配给不同的选项，而选择策略\(S( \cdot )\)则在所有仿真重复完成后做出最终决策，选择最佳选项。最优的A\(\&\)S策略\(({\cal A}^*,{S^*})\)满足Bellman方程。常见的假设选择策略是选择后验均值最大的选项，尽管它可能不是最优的选择策略。The dynamic decisions in the simulation sample allocation problem can be formulated as a dynamic allocation and selection (A\(\&\)S) policy. The allocation policy is a sequence of mappings \({{\cal A}}( \cdot ) = ({{\cal A}_1}( \cdot ), \ldots ,{{\cal A}_t}( \cdot ))\) that sequentially allocates each sample to an alternative based on collected information, and the selection policy \(S( \cdot )\) makes a final decision to select the best alternative after all simulation replications are exhausted. The optimal A\(\&\)S policy \(({\cal A}^*,{S^*})\) satisfies a Bellman equation. The commonly assumed selection policy chooses the alternative with the largest posterior mean, although it may not be the optimal selection policy.

一种源自近似动态规划范式的动态抽样程序旨在为贝尔曼方程找到合适的值函数近似（VFA）。一种简单的方法是固定选择策略，选择后验均值最大的备选方案，并用一步向前预测来分配下一次重复实验。因此，VFA 变成了标准正态密度在由 \(k-1\) 超平面定义的区域上的积分。将时间 \(t\) 时后验最佳方案的索引记作 \({\langle 1\rangle _t} = \arg {\max _{i}\mu _{i(t)}}\)，VFA 可以进一步简化为解析形式，从而得到以下渐近最优分配策略（AOAP），其形式反映了与 OCBA 公式类似的（后验）均值-方差权衡：A dynamic sampling procedure derived from an approximate dynamic programming paradigm aims to find a suitable value function approximation (VFA) for the Bellman equation. A simple approach fixes the selection policy to choose the alternative with the largest posterior mean and one-step-look-ahead for allocating the next replication. Consequently, the VFA becomes an integral of the standard normal density over a region defined by \(k-1\) hyperplanes.
