Denoting the index of the posterior-best alternative at time \(t\) by \({\langle 1\rangle _t} = \arg {\max _{i}\mu _{i(t)}}\), the VFA can be further simplified to an analytical form, leading to the following asymptotically optimal allocation policy (AOAP), whose form reflects a similar (posterior) mean-variance tradeoff as the OCBA formula:

\[\begin{equation*} {{\cal A}_{t + 1}}({{\cal E}_t}) = \arg {\max _{i = 1, \ldots ,K}}{\hat V_t}({{\cal E}_t};i), \end{equation*}\] 对于所有 \(j \ne {\langle 1\rangle _t}\)、\[\begin{equation*} {\hat V_t}\left( {{{\cal E}_t};j} \right) \buildrel\textstyle.\over= \min \left\{ {\frac{{{{\left( {\mu _{{{\langle 1\rangle }_t(t)}} - \mu _{j(t)}} \right)}^2}}}{{ {\sigma _{{\langle 1\rangle }_t(t)}^2} + {{{\sigma _{j(t + 1)}^2} }}}},{{\min }_{\ell \ne {{\langle 1\rangle }_t},j}}\frac{{{{\left( {\mu _{{{\langle 1\rangle }_t(t)}} - \mu _{\ell(t)} } \right)}^2}}}{{{{ {\sigma _{{{\langle 1\rangle }_t(t)}}^2} }} + {{ {\sigma _{\ell(t)} }^2 }}}}} \right\}, \end{equation*}\] 和 \[\begin{equation*} {\hat V_t}\left( {{{\cal E}_t};{{\langle 1\rangle }_t}} \right) \buildrel\textstyle.\over= {\min _{j \ne {{\langle 1\rangle }_t}}}\frac{{{{\left( {\mu _{{{\langle 1\rangle }_t(t)}} - \mu _{j{(t)}}} \right)}^2}}}{ \sigma _{{\langle 1\rangle }_t(t + 1)}^2 + \sigma _{j(t)}^2 }. \end{equation*}\]\[\begin{equation*} {{\cal A}_{t + 1}}({{\cal E}_t}) = \arg {\max _{i = 1, \ldots ,K}}{\hat V_t}({{\cal E}_t};i), \end{equation*}\] where for all \(j \ne {\langle 1\rangle _t}\), \[\begin{equation*} {\hat V_t}\left( {{{\cal E}_t};j} \right) \buildrel\textstyle.\over= \min \left\{ {\frac{{{{\left( {\mu _{{{\langle 1\rangle }_t(t)}} - \mu _{j(t)}} \right)}^2}}}{{ {\sigma _{{\langle 1\rangle }_t(t)}^2} + {{{\sigma _{j(t + 1)}^2} }}}},{{\min }_{\ell \ne {{\langle 1\rangle }_t},j}}\frac{{{{\left( {\mu _{{{\langle 1\rangle }_t(t)}} - \mu _{\ell(t)} } \right)}^2}}}{{{{ {\sigma _{{{\langle 1\rangle }_t(t)}}^2} }} + {{ {\sigma _{\ell(t)} }^2 }}}}} \right\}, \end{equation*}\] and \[\begin{equation*} {\hat V_t}\left( {{{\cal E}_t};{{\langle 1\rangle }_t}} \right) \buildrel\textstyle.\over= {\min _{j \ne {{\langle 1\rangle }_t}}}\frac{{{{\left( {\mu _{{{\langle 1\rangle }_t(t)}} - \mu _{j{(t)}}} \right)}^2}}}{ \sigma _{{\langle 1\rangle }_t(t + 1)}^2 + \sigma _{j(t)}^2 }. \end{equation*}\]

在AOAP的背景下，一致性指的是当分配的样本数量趋于无穷时，算法正确识别最佳备选方案的能力，表示为 \[\begin{equation*} {\lim _{t \to \infty }}\hat S({{\cal E}_t}) = *. \end{equation*}\]。这一特性保证了在样本足够的情况下，AOAP能可靠地收敛到最优解，从而减少有限样本情况下误识别的风险。此外，每个备选方案的采样比例 \(r_k^{(t)}:= n_k/t\) 在渐进上实现了误选概率的最优大偏差衰减率：Consistency, in the context of AOAP, refers to the algorithm’s ability to correctly identify the best alternative as the number of allocated samples tends to infinity, expressed as \[\begin{equation*} {\lim _{t \to \infty }}\hat S({{\cal E}_t}) = *. \end{equation*}\] This property ensures that, given sufficient samples, AOAP reliably converges to the optimal solution, thereby mitigating the risk of misidentification inherent in finite-sample scenarios. Moreover, the sampling ratio for each alternative, \(r_k^{(t)}:= n_k/t\), asymptotically achieves the optimal large deviations decay rates for the probability of false selection:

\[\begin{equation*} \mathop {\lim }\limits_{t \to \infty } r_i^{(t)} = r_i^{\rm LD} ~\mbox{a.s.} ~\forall i, \end{equation*}\]

\[\begin{equation*} \frac{{{{\left( {{\mu_i} - {\mu_*}} \right)}^2}}}{{{{\left( {{\sigma_i}} \right)}^2}/r_i^{\rm LD} + {{\left( {{\sigma_*}} \right)}^2}/r_*^{\rm LD}}} = \frac{{{{\left( {{\mu _{\langle j\rangle }} - {\mu _*}} \right)}^2}}}{{{{\left( {{\sigma _{\langle j\rangle }}} \right)}^2}/r_{\langle j\rangle }^{\rm LD} + {{\left( {{\sigma _*}} \right)}^2}/r_*^{\rm LD}}}, ~i,j \ne *, \end{equation*}\] \[\begin{equation*} \left( \frac{r_*^{\rm LD}}{\sigma _i} \right)^2 = \sum\limits_{i \ne *} {\left( \frac{r_i^{\rm LD}}{{\sigma _i}} \right)}^2. \end{equation*}\]

用于排序与选择的多臂老虎机模型 Bandit Models for Ranking and Selection

多臂老虎机（MAB）问题和统计R&S有类似的总体目标，因为两者都旨在从一组未知期望值的备选方案中找出最佳选项（就像老式机械老虎机中的“臂”一样）。不过，标准MAB问题的目标是最大化累计期望收益，而R&S的目标则是最大化概率选择最佳方案（PCS）或确保其超过期望水平。后者可以看作前者的“特例”，只是在结束时获得一个单一的二元奖励，而过程中的其他奖励都没有，这在MAB领域被称为最佳臂识别（BAI）问题。The multi-armed bandit (MAB) problem has a similar overarching goal as statistical R&S, in that both aim to identify the best option (referred to as “arms” as in the old-fashioned mechanical slot machines) from a set of alternatives with unknown expected means. However, the objective of the standard MAB problem is to maximize cumulative expected rewards, whereas the objective of R&S is to maximize PCS or ensure that it exceeds a desired level. The latter can be viewed as a “special case” of the former by taking just a single binary reward at termination with no other rewards along the way, and this is known as the best-arm identification (BAI) problem in the MAB community.

虽然多臂老虎机（MAB）问题是以奖励描述的，其目标是选择臂序列 \(A_1, A_2, \ldots, A_N\)，使 \[\mathbb{E}\left[\sum_{t=1}^N \mu_{A_t} \right],\] 最大化，但标准求解方法是分析拉臂 \(N\) 次之后的期望累积遗憾，其定义为Although the MAB problem is described in terms of rewards, with the goal is to choose a sequence of arms \(A_1, A_2, \ldots, A_N\) to maximize \[\mathbb{E}\left[\sum_{t=1}^N \mu_{A_t} \right],\] the standard solution approach is to analyze the expected cumulative regret after \(N\) “pulls” of the arms, as defined by

\[\begin{equation*} R(T) =\mathbb{E} \left[\mathop \sum \limits_{t = 1}^N ({\mu_*} - {\mu _{{A_t}}})\right]. \end{equation*}\]

正如之前提到的，一个最优策略需要在利用（选择当前估计均值高的臂）和探索（选择不确定性高的臂）之间取得平衡。纯探索策略则会简单地选择当前估计均值最高的臂，无论是在频率主义下使用样本均值，还是在贝叶斯下使用后验分布的均值。As alluded to earlier, an optimal policy balances exploitation (sampling arms with currently high estimated means) and exploration (sampling arms with high uncertainty). A pure exploration policy would simply select the arm with the current highest estimated mean, whether using the sample mean in the frequentist setting or the mean of the posterior distribution in the Bayesian setting.

一个被广泛使用的算法，由于其计算简单，因此容易实现，就是上置信界（UCB）算法，它只需选择当前 UCB 值最高的动作（臂），即 \[A_t = \arg {\max _k} ~ {\rm UCB}_k^{(t)},\]，其中 \({\rm UCB}_k^{(t)}\) 是每个臂 \(k\) 在 \(t\) 次总操作后的运行索引，定义为样本平均值 \(\bar{X}_k(n_k^{(t)})\)，其中 \(n_k^{(t)}\) 是在 \(t\) 次总操作后某臂 \(k\) 的操作次数，再加上一些考虑不确定性的“调节”因子：通常是该臂（未知）奖励分布的标准差或范围的某个倍数，这个倍数反映了在利用与探索之间的权衡，权重为零表示纯粹利用。在 AI/ML 社区里，一般假设这个范围是已知的，并且通常缩放到 [0,1] 区间，而在统计学和 SO 社区里，方差通常被认为是未知的，因此通过样本方差来估计。 MCTS 是在已知范围的 UCB 下引入的，因为它的主要应用动机是游戏，如果奖励是获胜的概率，那么它的取值范围就是 [0,1]，每个臂的 UCB 指数可以采用 \[{\rm UCB}_k^{(t)} := \bar{X}_k(n_k^{(t)}) + \sqrt{\frac{2\ln t}{n_k^{(t)}}}.\] 这种形式。A widely used algorithm, due to its computational simplicity and hence ease of implementation, is the upper confidence bound (UCB) algorithm, which simply pulls (chooses) the arm with the highest UCB, i.e., \[A_t = \arg {\max _k} ~ {\rm UCB}_k^{(t)},\] where \({\rm UCB}_k^{(t)}\) is a running index for each arm \(k\) after \(t\) total pulls, defined as the sample mean \(\bar{X}_k(n_k^{(t)})\), where \(n_k^{(t)}\) is the number of pulls of arm \(k\) after \(t\) total pulls, plus some “fudge” factor that accounts for uncertainty: generally some multiple of either the standard deviation or the range of the arm’s (unknown) reward distribution, where the multiplicative factor reflects the weighting to balance exploitation and exploration, with a weight of zero reflecting pure exploitation. In the AI/ML community, it is commonly assumed that the range is known and often scaled to the interval [0,1], whereas in the statistics and SO community, the variance is usually assumed to be unknown and hence estimated by the sample variance. MCTS was introduced using UCB with known range, because its main motivating application was games, where if the reward was the probability of winning, then its support would be [0,1], and the UCB index for each arm could take the form \[{\rm UCB}_k^{(t)} := \bar{X}_k(n_k^{(t)}) + \sqrt{\frac{2\ln t}{n_k^{(t)}}}.\]

虽然UCB方法简单且易于实现，但通常可以通过使用Thompson采样（TS）获得更好的性能。TS是一种贝叶斯算法，它会对每个臂的平均回报保持一个后验分布，并根据它们成为最优的概率来选择臂。具体来说，TS会从每个臂\(k\)的后验分布中为\(\mu _k\)采样\(\theta_k\)，其中\(\theta_k\)指的是之前定义的全局参数\(\theta\)的一个组成部分，然后选择（拉取）下一个回报中采样\(\theta_k\)值最高的臂:Although UCB is straightforward and easy to implement, better performance can often be obtained using Thompson sampling (TS), which is a Bayesian algorithm that maintains a posterior distribution over each arm’s mean reward and selects arms based on the probability that they are optimal. Specifically, TS samples \(\theta_k\) from the posterior distribution for \(\mu _k\) for each arm \(k\), where \(\theta_k\) refers to a component of the global parameter \(\theta\) defined earlier, and then the arm with the highest sampled \(\theta_k\) is chosen (pulled) for the next reward:

\[\begin{equation*} {A_t} = \arg {\max _k} {\, \theta _k}. \end{equation*}\]

虽然 TS 在传统 MAB 设置中最小化累积遗憾时表现出色，但由于对接近最优的臂探索不足，它在最优臂识别（BAI）或排序与选择（R&S）任务中的表现往往较弱。双候选汤普森采样（TTTS）通过从后验分布中采样两个候选臂，再按概率从中选择一个，增强探索。具体而言，TTTS 首先独立抽取两个参数向量样本，分别确定各样本下的最优臂。随后，以概率 \(p\) 选择第一个采样得到的臂，以概率 \(1-p\) 选择第二个不同的臂。这使样本不仅更可能分配给后验意义下的最优臂，也会分配给那些具有不可忽略的后验最优概率的臂，从而提高仿真分配任务中的正确选择概率（PCS）。While TS has demonstrated strong performance in minimizing cumulative regret in traditional MAB settings, it often underperforms in BAI or R&S tasks due to insufficient exploration of near-optimal arms. The Top-Two Thompson Sampling (TTTS) procedure enhances exploration by sampling **two candidate arms** from the posterior distribution and probabilistically selecting between them. Specifically, TTTS first draws two independent samples of the parameter vector and identifies the corresponding best arms under each. It then selects the first sampled arm with probability \(p\), and the second (distinct) one with probability \(1-p\). This approach increases the likelihood of allocating samples not only to the posterior-best arm, but also to arms with non-negligible posterior optimality, thereby improving PCS in simulation allocation tasks.

经典 TS 按照各臂为最优臂的后验概率进行采样；TTTS 则显式地在领先候选臂之间引入随机竞争，而且在贝叶斯模型下，这些领先候选臂的身份本身也是随机的。Unlike classical TS, which samples each arm in proportion to its posterior probability of being optimal, TTTS explicitly introduces randomized competition between the top candidates—whose identities are themselves random under the Bayesian model.

2.3 连续随机优化2.3 Continuous Stochastic Optimization

本节考虑如下随机优化问题：In this section, we consider the stochastic optimization problem:

\[\begin{equation} {\min _{\theta \in \Theta }}f(\theta), \end{equation}\] 其中，\(f(\theta) =\mathbb{E}[Y(\theta;\omega )]\)，\(Y(\theta;\omega )\) 为样本性能，\(\omega\) 表示随机因素，\(\Theta \subseteq \mathbb R{^d}\) 是连续参数空间。目标是找到最优解\[\begin{equation} {\min _{\theta \in \Theta }}f(\theta), \end{equation}\] where \(f(\theta) =\mathbb{E}[Y(\theta;\omega )]\) for \(Y(\theta;\omega )\) a sample performance, \(\omega\) denotes the stochastic effects, and \(\Theta \subseteq \mathbb R{^d}\) is a continuous parameter space. The objective is to find an optimal solution

\[\begin{equation*} {\theta^*} \in \arg {\min _{\theta \in \Theta }}f(\theta). \end{equation*}\]

我们重点讨论两类迭代方法：使用梯度搜索的随机近似方法（在 AI/ML 中称为随机梯度下降），以及响应面方法。第 2.5 节回顾主要的随机梯度估计技术。We focus on two iterative approaches: stochastic approximation, which uses gradient-based search (stochastic gradient descent in AI/ML), and response surface methods. Section 2.5 provides a review of the main stochastic gradient estimation techniques.

随机近似（SA）Stochastic Approximation (SA)

随机近似是求解式（2.4）的迭代算法，与确定性优化中的最速下降法相对应：Stochastic Approximation is an iterative algorithm for solving (2.4) that parallels steepest descent in deterministic optimization:

\[\begin{equation} {\theta_{n + 1}} = {\Pi _\Theta }\left( {{\theta_n} - {a_n} \widehat{ \nabla f}({\theta_n})} \right), \end{equation}\]

其中，当 \(\theta \notin \Theta\) 时，\({\Pi _\Theta }(\theta)\) 将 \(\theta\) 投影回可行域 \(\Theta\)；\({a_n}{\rm{ }} > {\rm{ }}0\) 是步长系数，\(\widehat{ \nabla f}({\theta_n})\) 是梯度 \(\nabla f({\theta_n})\) 的估计量。只有在带约束的问题中才需要投影算子；若求解最大化问题，则应将式（2.5）中的符号反转。Robbins–Monro（RM）算法对 \(\nabla f(\theta)\) 使用无偏估计量，而 Kiefer–Wolfowitz（KW）算法使用有限差分估计。在某些条件下，RM 和 KW 的渐近收敛速率分别为 \(O({n^{ - 1/2}})\) 和 \(O({n^{ - 1/3}})\)。where \({\Pi _\Theta }(\theta)\) projects \(\theta\) back into the feasible region \(\Theta\) if \(\theta \notin \Theta\), \({a_n}{\rm{ }} > {\rm{ }}0\) is the step size multiplier, \(\widehat{ \nabla f}({\theta_n})\) is an estimate of the gradient \(\nabla f({\theta_n})\). The projection operator is only required in the constrained setting, and a maximization problem would reverse the sign in (2.5). The Robbins-Monro (RM) algorithm uses an unbiased estimator for \(\nabla f(\theta)\), whereas the Kiefer-Wolfowitz (KW) algorithm employs finite-difference estimates. Under certain conditions, RM and KW have asymptotic convergence rates of \(O({n^{ - 1/2}})\) and \(O({n^{ - 1/3}})\), respectively.

下一章将在 AI/ML 环境中讨论 SA 算法的有限时间性能，但步长序列 \(\{a_n\}\)、梯度估计器 \(\widehat{ \nabla f}({\theta_n})\) 和投影算子 \({\Pi _\Theta }\) 的选择都会显著影响算法性能，KW 算法中有限差分估计的扰动大小序列也是如此。（随机）梯度估计技术将在第 2.5 节介绍。这里我们简单讨论一下影响 SA 性能的其他因素。The SA algorithm’s finite-time performance is discussed in the next chapter in AI/ML settings, but the choices of step-size sequence \(\{a_n\}\), gradient estimator \(\widehat{ \nabla f}({\theta_n})\), and projection operator \({\Pi _\Theta }\) significantly impact the algorithm’s performance, as does the perturbation size sequence for the finite-difference estimates in the KW algorithm. (Stochastic) gradient estimation techniques will be described in Section 2.5. We briefly discuss the other factors that influence SA performance here.

众所周知，在实际实现中通常需要调整序列 \(\{a_n\}\)：若 \({a_n}\) 过大，算法可能来回振荡，无法接近最优解 \({\theta^*}\)；若 \({a_n}\) 过小，收敛速度则很慢，迭代点可能几乎不移动。It is well known that the sequence \(\{a_n\}\) often requires tuning in practical implementation, because if \({a_n}\) is too large, the algorithm may oscillate without approaching the optimum \({\theta^*}\), whereas if \({a_n}\) is too small, convergence is slow, and the iterates may barely move.

自适应步长规则可以用来减轻对步长序列的敏感性。例如，在标量情况下 \(d\)=1，Kesten 的规则只有在迭代方向发生变化时才减小步长，即 \(\left( {{\theta_{n + 1}} - {\rm{ }}{\theta_n}} \right)\left( {{\theta_n}{\rm{ }} - {\rm{ }}{\theta_{n - 1}}} \right){\rm{ }} < {\rm{ }}0\)。在多维情况下 \(d>1\)，方向变化可以通过内积 \(\langle \theta_{n+1} - \theta_n,\, \theta_n - \theta_{n-1} \rangle < 0\) 来评估。这种自适应步长在迭代向同一方向移动时保持动量，表明它们可能距离最优值较远。这种思路的一个延伸是，当连续估计误差符号相同时，可以增加步长以加快收敛。另一种选择是通过估计逆 Hessian 来模拟确定性牛顿-拉弗森方法。Adaptive step-size rules can be used to mitigate sensitivity to the step-size sequence. For example, in the scalar case \(d\)=1, Kesten’s rule decreases the step size only when there is a directional change in the iterates, i.e., \(\left( {{\theta_{n + 1}} - {\rm{ }}{\theta_n}} \right)\left( {{\theta_n}{\rm{ }} - {\rm{ }}{\theta_{n - 1}}} \right){\rm{ }} < {\rm{ }}0\). In the multi-dimensional case \(d>1\), directional change can be assessed via the inner product \(\langle \theta_{n+1} - \theta_n,\, \theta_n - \theta_{n-1} \rangle < 0\). This adaptive step size maintains momentum when iterates move in the same direction, indicating they may be far from the optimum. An extension of this idea is to increase the step size to speed up convergence when consecutive errors in estimates have the same sign. Another alternative is to mimic the deterministic Newton-Raphson method by estimating the inverse Hessian.

迭代平均是一种常用的技术，用于提高估计最优解的稳健性。该方法结合了较大的步长和对最近一部分迭代结果的平均，然后将平均结果作为估计的最优解，从而减少对最后一次迭代的依赖。实现起来很简单，它的稳健性体现在对初始步长选择的敏感性降低。在适当的条件下，迭代平均表现出\(O({n^{ - 1/2}})\)渐近收敛速率。Iterate averaging is a commonly employed technique for enhancing the robustness in estimating the optimal solution. This approach combines larger step-sizes with averaging a subset of the most recent iterates that is returned as estimated optimum, thus decreasing reliance on the last iterate. Easy to implement, its robustness includes reduced sensitivity to the initial step size choice. Under appropriate conditions, iterative averaging exhibits \(O({n^{ - 1/2}})\) asymptotic convergence rate.

迭代平均的一种推广是稳健随机近似（RSA）算法，它使用步长序列 \(a_n\) 来对迭代进行加权。另一种推广是在目标函数中引入一个函数，作为正则化项，以防止下一次迭代 \(\theta_{n+1}\) 离 \(\theta_{n}\) 太远。A generalization of iterate averaging is the robust stochastic approximation (RSA) algorithm, which uses the step-size sequence \(a_n\) for weighting the iterates. Another generalization introduces a function into the objective function, acting as a regularization term to prevent the next iterate \(\theta_{n+1}\) from being too far from \(\theta_{n}\).

早期的SA渐近理论假设目标函数满足特定的全局条件，比如在原始求根问题中的单调性以及优化问题中的凸性。放宽这些条件的方法只要求这些条件在包含最优解的紧致集合内成立，并允许在SA算法中自适应使用投影算子，即使对于无约束优化问题也是如此。实际上，投影集合\(\Theta\)必须选择为包含（未知的）最优解\(\theta^*\)；然而，如果将\(\Theta\)设得比必要的要大得多，可能会通过扩大搜索空间来减缓收敛速度。自适应地增加搜索空间可以在使用适当投影算子的情况下，实现可证明的收敛，例如将迭代点自适应地投影到一个不断增大的紧致集合上。Early asymptotic theory for SA assumed the the objective function satisfy specific global conditions such as monotonicity in the original root-finding problem and convexity for optimization. Relaxations include only requiring such conditions to hold within a compact set containing the optimum, allowing the projection operator to be used adaptively in the SA algorithm, even for an unconstrained optimization problem. In practice, the projection set \(\Theta\) must be chosen to include the (unknown) optimal solution \(\theta^*\); however, making \(\Theta\) much larger than necessary can slow convergence by enlarging the search space. Adaptively increasing the search space can lead to provable convergence with an appropriate projection operator, such as adaptively projecting the iterates onto an increasing compact set.

在 KW 型 SA 算法中使用的有限差分梯度估计在高维下会变得计算量很大，因为计算成本会随着参数维度线性增加。而同时扰动随机近似（SPSA）只需要对目标函数进行两次估计就能近似梯度，因此计算成本不受参数空间维度的影响。Finite difference gradient estimates used in KW-type SA algorithms become computationally expensive in high dimensions, since the computational cost grows linearly with the parameter dimension. Simultaneous Perturbation Stochastic Approximation (SPSA) requires only two estimates of the objective function to approximate the gradient, making the computational cost independent of the parameter space dimension.

响应面方法Response Surface Methods

响应面方法通常用于连续优化问题，用来学习输入–输出关系，并用一个曲面来近似底层模拟，这个曲面被称为元模型或代理模型。这种函数形式可以使用强大的基于导数的优化技术。在文献中，响应面方法也被称为多学科设计优化、基于元模型的优化和顺序参数优化，最初是为物理过程的实验设计而开发的。Response surface methods are typically used in continuous optimization problems to learn input–output relationships and approximate the underlying simulation with a surface, known as a meta model or surrogate model. This functional form allows the use of powerful derivative-based optimization techniques. Response surface methods are referred to in the literature as multi-disciplinary design optimization, metamodel-based optimization, and sequential parameter optimization, and were initially developed for experimental design in physical processes.

不同的响应面算法在几个方面有所不同：选择回归还是插值；用于近似的函数形式的类型（多项式、样条、克里金法、径向基函数、神经网络）；确定新样本数量和位置的方法；更新响应面的方式。RSM 方法可以在局部区域建立有效的代理模型，并顺序使用这些模型来引导搜索；或者使用填充空间设计为整个参数空间构建代理模型，然后在可能找到更好解的区域进行采样。Different response surface algorithms vary in several ways: the choice between regression and interpolation; the nature of the functional form used for approximation (polynomials, splines, kriging, radial basis functions, neural networks); the method for determining the number and location of new samples; the approach to updating the response surface. RSM approaches can build effective surrogate models in local regions and use these models sequentially to guide the search; construct surrogate models for the entire parameter space using space-filling designs, and then sample in areas where finding better solutions is likely.

为了解决SO问题，提出了一种两阶段的顺序响应面方法（RSM）:To address SO problems, a two-phase sequential response surface methodology (RSM) was proposed:

  • 第一阶段（迭代）：使用试验设计得到的样本建立一阶模型。根据一阶拟合曲面导出的梯度估计，沿改善目标的方向移动。重复这一过程，直到估计梯度接近零。Phase I (iterative): Build a first-order model using samples from a design of experiments. Based on a gradient estimate derived from the first-order fitted surface, move in an improving direction. Repeat until the estimated gradient was close to zero.

  • 第二阶段：构建更精细的二次模型，以得到最终的最优解估计。Phase II: Construct a more detailed quadratic model to derive a final estimated optimum.

信赖域方法可以通过控制近似区域并为代理模型提供更新准则来实现序贯响应面方法，有助于分析收敛性。一旦在信赖域中心 \({\theta_i}\) 周围建立了一个元模型或响应面 \(f\)，信赖域算法就涉及求解信赖域子问题 \(\min f({\theta_i} + s)\)，并受制于 \(s \in B({\theta_i},\Delta )\)，其中 \(B\) 是由中心-半径对 \(({\theta_i},\Delta )\) 定义的球，并且用于更新信赖域中心和半径的准则也已明确。Trust region methods can be used to implement sequential RSM by controlling the region of approximation and providing update criteria for surrogate models, aiding in analyzing convergence properties. Once a metamodel or response surface \(f\) is built around a trust region center \({\theta_i}\), trust region algorithms involve solving the trust-region subproblem \(\min f({\theta_i} + s)\) subject to \(s \in B({\theta_i},\Delta )\), where \(B\) is a ball defined by the center-radius pair \(({\theta_i},\Delta )\) and criteria for updating the trust region center and radius are well-defined.

因为序贯 RSM是一种基于梯度的搜索方法，所以容易陷入局部最优，因此一种替代方法是顺序构建全局响应面，而贝叶斯方法非常适合这种方式，最常用的实现技术包括克里金/高斯过程回归。随后的样本选择是基于改进指标来平衡利用和探索。具体的指标包括期望改进、信息期望值、知识梯度、最可能的改进和最大信息增益。Because sequential RSM is a gradient-based search method, it is prone to getting caught in local optima, so an alternative approach is to build a global response surface sequentially, for which Bayesian methods are well suited, most commonly implemented using techniques such as kriging/Gaussian process regression. Subsequent samples are chosen based on an improvement metric to balance exploitation and exploration. Specific metrics include expected improvement, expected value of information, knowledge gradient, most probable improvement, and maximum information gain.

2.4 马尔可夫决策过程2.4 Markov Decision Processes

马尔可夫决策过程提供了一个正式的数学框架，用于在不确定性下建模序贯决策。决策者选择一个动作，获得奖励（或承担成本），然后系统状态随机转移，其动态仅取决于当前系统状态和所选择的动作。这个过程会重复进行，直到问题的时间范围结束。形式上，MDP由一个元组 \((S, A, P, R)\) 定义，其中 \(S\) 是状态集合，\(A\) 是动作集合，\(P(s' \mid s, a)\) 表示在采取动作 \(a\) 后从状态 \(s\) 转移到状态 \(s'\) 的转移概率，而 \(R(s, a)\) 是奖励函数，指定在状态 \(s\) 执行动作 \(a\) 时获得的即时（一阶段）奖励。一个更通用的MDP模型会将奖励视为随机并依赖于下一个状态。 为了讲解方便，我们假设状态空间和动作空间都是有限的，并且所有基础模型参数（比如可行动作空间和单期奖励）都是时间齐次的。Markov decision processes provide a formal mathematical framework for modeling sequential decision-making under uncertainty. A decision maker chooses an action, receives a reward (or incurs a cost), and then the system state transitions stochastically, with its dynamics depending only on the current system state and the chosen action. This is repeated until the end of the problem horizon. Formally, an MDP is defined by a tuple \((S, A, P, R)\), where \(S\) is a set of states, \(A\) is a set of actions, \(P(s' \mid s, a)\) denotes the transition probability of moving from state \(s\) to state \(s'\) after taking action \(a\), and \(R(s, a)\) is the reward function that specifies the immediate (one-period) reward received for performing action \(a\) in state \(s\). A more general MDP model would take the reward as random and depending on the next state. For simplicity of exposition, we assume both state and action spaces are finite, and time-homogeneity for all of the underlying model parameters such as the feasible action space and one-period reward.

一个策略 \(\pi: S \rightarrow A\) 是从状态到动作的映射，用来指定在特定状态下采取什么动作。这个定义提供了一个确定性策略，而随机策略则会映射到动作集合上的概率分布，对于随机策略，我们会写成 \(\pi(a|s)\)，表示在状态 \(s\) 下采取动作 \(a\) 的概率。解决一个 MDP 模型意味着找到一个策略，使某种累计奖励函数达到最优化。A policy \(\pi: S \rightarrow A\) is a mapping from states to actions, specifying what action to take in a given state. This definition provides a deterministic policy, whereas a randomized policy would map to a probability distribution over the set of actions, for which we would write \(\pi(a|s)\) as the probability of taking action \(a\) in state \(s\). Solving an MDP model means finding a policy that optimizes some function of the cumulative rewards.

我们考虑这样一个情境：找到一个最优策略 \(\pi^*\)，它可以最大化从初始状态 \(s_0\) 开始、在一段时间内累积折扣奖励的期望值，这由 \[\sum_{i=0}^T \gamma^i R(s_{i},\pi(s_{i})),\] 定义，其中 \(s_i\) 是第 \(i\) 期的状态，\(\gamma \in [0,1]\) 是折扣因子，\(T\) 是时间范围，可以是有限的或无限的，固定的或随机的（比如停止时间）。另一种扩展是初始状态由一个分布指定。We consider the setting of finding an optimal policy \(\pi^*\) that maximizes the expected value of the cumulative discounted reward over time starting from initial state \(s_0\), defined by \[\sum_{i=0}^T \gamma^i R(s_{i},\pi(s_{i})),\] where \(s_i\) is the state in period \(i\), \(\gamma \in [0,1]\) is the discount factor, and \(T\) is the time horizon, which could be finite or infinite, fixed or random (e.g., a stopping time). Another extension is the initial state specified by a distribution.

如果知道MDP模型的所有组成部分——最重要的是转移动态和奖励函数，那么在有限时间范围的问题中就可以使用动态规划方法来求解最优解。If all the components of the MDP model are known – most importantly the transition dynamics and reward function, then dynamic programming methods can be used to solve for the optimal solution in finite-horizon problems.

下文考虑无限时域问题，常用求解方法包括价值迭代与策略迭代。它们依赖于价值函数的贝尔曼方程所给出的递推关系。对于固定策略 \(\pi\) 和初始状态 \(s_0 = s\)，价值函数定义为 \[V^\pi(s) = E \left[ \sum_{i=0}^{\infty} \gamma^i R(s_{i},\pi(s_{i})) \right],\]。贝尔曼方程为 \(V^{\pi}\) 给出如下递推关系：\[\begin{equation} V^\pi(s) = R(s,\pi(s)) + \gamma \sum_{s^\prime \in S} P(s^\prime \mid s,\pi(s)) V^\pi(s^\prime), ~\forall s \in S, \end{equation}\]，其中 \(V^\pi(s)\) 表示从状态 \(s\) 出发并遵循策略 \(\pi\) 时的期望累积奖励。对于随机化策略，贝尔曼方程为：\[\begin{equation} V^\pi(s) = \sum_{a \in A} \pi(a \mid s) \left[ R(s,a) + \gamma \sum_{s^\prime \in S} P(s^\prime \mid s,a) V^\pi(s^\prime) \right], ~\forall s \in S. \end{equation}\]Henceforth, we consider infinite-horizon problems, where methods such as value iteration and policy iteration are used, which rely on recursions based on the Bellman equation for the value function, which is defined as follows for a fixed policy \(\pi\): \[V^\pi(s) = E \left[ \sum_{i=0}^{\infty} \gamma^i R(s_{i},\pi(s_{i})) \right],\] for initial state \(s_0 = s\). The Bellman equation provides the following recursive relationship for \(V^{\pi}\): \[\begin{equation} V^\pi(s) = R(s,\pi(s)) + \gamma \sum_{s^\prime \in S} P(s^\prime \mid s,\pi(s)) V^\pi(s^\prime), ~\forall s \in S, \end{equation}\] where \(V^\pi(s)\) represents the expected cumulative reward starting from state \(s\) and following policy \(\pi\). For a randomized policy, the Bellman equation would be the following: \[\begin{equation} V^\pi(s) = \sum_{a \in A} \pi(a \mid s) \left[ R(s,a) + \gamma \sum_{s^\prime \in S} P(s^\prime \mid s,a) V^\pi(s^\prime) \right], ~\forall s \in S. \end{equation}\]

最优价值函数为 \[\begin{equation} V^*(s) = \max_{\pi \in \Pi} V^{\pi}(s), ~\forall s \in S, \end{equation}\]，其中 \(\Pi\) 是可行策略集合，而最优策略必须满足 \[\pi^*(s) \in \arg\max_{\pi \in \Pi} V^{\pi}(s), ~\forall s \in S.\]。The optimal value function is given by \[\begin{equation} V^*(s) = \max_{\pi \in \Pi} V^{\pi}(s), ~\forall s \in S, \end{equation}\] where \(\Pi\) is the set of feasible policies, and an optimal policy must then satisfy \[\pi^*(s) \in \arg\max_{\pi \in \Pi} V^{\pi}(s), ~\forall s \in S.\]

在强化学习中，一个重要的概念是 Q 函数，它表示在状态 \(s\) 下采取动作 \(a\) 后的期望回报，然后再遵循最优策略，其定义为 \[Q(s,a) = R(s,a) + \sum_{s^\prime \in S} P(s^\prime \mid s,a) \gamma V^*(s^\prime), ~\forall s \in S.\]。根据这个定义，最优价值函数可以表示为 \[V^*(s) = \max_{a \in A} Q(s,a), ~\forall s \in S,\]，最优策略 \(\pi^*(s)\) 可以表示为选择使 Q 值最大的动作：\[\pi^*(s) \in \arg\max_{a \in A} Q(s, a), ~\forall s \in S.\]。An important concept in RL is the Q-function, which represents the expected return of taking action \(a\) in state \(s\), and then following the optimal policy thereafter, defined by \[Q(s,a) = R(s,a) + \sum_{s^\prime \in S} P(s^\prime \mid s,a) \gamma V^*(s^\prime), ~\forall s \in S.\] Using this definition, the optimal value function can be expressed as \[V^*(s) = \max_{a \in A} Q(s,a), ~\forall s \in S,\] and the optimal policy \(\pi^*(s)\) can be expressed as selecting the action that maximizes the Q-value: \[\pi^*(s) \in \arg\max_{a \in A} Q(s, a), ~\forall s \in S.\]

要求解最优策略，有两种广泛使用的方法：价值迭代和策略迭代。价值迭代是一种迭代方法，通过基于有限时间范围的贝尔曼最优方程不断更新价值函数 \(V^*(s)\)，本质上是在进行动态规划。在每次迭代 \(k\) 中，一个状态的价值会根据 (参见 (2.6) & (2.8)) \[V_{k+1}(s) = \max_{a \in A} \left[ R(s,a) + \gamma \sum_{s^\prime \in S} P(s^\prime \mid s,a) V_k(s^\prime) \right], ~\forall s \in S,\] 进行更新，继续迭代直到价值收敛到一个很小的阈值，此时就找到最优价值函数 \(V^*(s)\)。一旦价值函数收敛，就可以通过在每个状态选择能最大化期望价值的动作来导出最优策略 \(\pi^*\)：\[\pi^*(s) \in \arg\max_{a \in A} \left[ R(s,a) + \gamma \sum_{s^\prime \in S} P(s^\prime \mid s,a) V^*(s^\prime) \right], \forall s \in S.\]To solve for the optimal policy, two widely-used methods are value iteration and policy iteration. Value iteration is an iterative approach that finds the optimal value function \(V^*(s)\) by repeatedly updating the value function based on the finite-horizon Bellman optimality equation, essentially carrying out dynamic programming. At each iteration \(k\), the value of a state is updated according to (cf. (2.6) & (2.8)) \[V_{k+1}(s) = \max_{a \in A} \left[ R(s,a) + \gamma \sum_{s^\prime \in S} P(s^\prime \mid s,a) V_k(s^\prime) \right], ~\forall s \in S,\] continuing the iteration until the values converge to within a small threshold, at which point the optimal value function \(V^*(s)\) is found. Once the value function converges, the optimal policy \(\pi^*\) can be derived by selecting the action that maximizes the expected value at each state: \[\pi^*(s) \in \arg\max_{a \in A} \left[ R(s,a) + \gamma \sum_{s^\prime \in S} P(s^\prime \mid s,a) V^*(s^\prime) \right], \forall s \in S.\]

策略迭代采取了一种不同的方法，通过在两个步骤之间交替进行——策略评估和策略改进——如下所示：Policy iteration takes a different approach by alternating between two steps, policy evaluation and policy improvement, as follows:

  • 策略评估：对给定策略 \(\pi\)，通过为每个状态 \(s \in S\) 求解贝尔曼方程，计算价值函数 \(V^\pi(s)\)；依据策略类型，使用式（2.6）或式（2.7）。Policy evaluation: The value function \(V^\pi(s)\) for a given policy \(\pi\) is computed by solving the Bellman equation – either (2.6) or (2.7), depending on the type of policy – for each state \(s \in S\).

  • 策略改进：对每个状态，选择使期望回报最大的动作来更新策略：\[\pi^\prime(s) \in \arg\max_{a \in A} \left[ R(s,a) + \gamma \sum_{s^\prime \in S} P(s^\prime \mid s,a) V^\pi(s^\prime) \right],~\forall s \in S.\]Policy improvement: The policy is updated by choosing the action that maximizes the expected return for each state: \[\pi^\prime(s) \in \arg\max_{a \in A} \left[ R(s,a) + \gamma \sum_{s^\prime \in S} P(s^\prime \mid s,a) V^\pi(s^\prime) \right],~\forall s \in S.\]

策略改进步骤确保新策略 \(\pi^\prime\) 至少和旧策略 \(\pi\) 一样好，如果没有进一步改进的可能，算法就会终止。由于每次迭代都会改进策略，并且存在有限数量的稳定策略，这个过程保证会在有限的迭代次数内收敛到最优策略 \(\pi^*\)。The policy improvement step ensures that the new policy \(\pi^\prime\) is at least as good as the old policy \(\pi\), and if no further improvement is possible, the algorithm terminates. Since each iteration improves the policy and there are a finite number of stationary policies, the process is guaranteed to converge to the optimal policy \(\pi^*\) in a finite number of iterations.

2.5 随机梯度估计2.5 Stochastic Gradient Estimation

梯度估计器对于用于优化的随机近似（SA）算法的成功至关重要。最常用的梯度估计方法采用有限差分，仅需要性能估计而不需要了解底层系统，就像黑箱模拟一样。然而，如果测量波动很大，基于有限差分的梯度估计可能会很嘈杂，而且在高维情况下计算成本也会很高，因为为了获得一个估计值，所需的样本数或仿真重复次数会随着参数维度线性增长。此外，有限差分估计通常是有偏的。在本节中，我们将讨论主要的“直接”随机梯度估计技术，这些技术提供无偏估计器，具体包括基于扰动分析、似然比法和弱导数法的方法。 其中许多只需要一次模拟复制就能同时提供输出性能及其梯度的估计。The gradient estimator is key to the success of an SA algorithm used for optimization. The most readily available gradient estimates employ finite differences, requiring only performance estimates and no knowledge of the underlying system, as in black-box simulation. However, finite-difference-based gradient estimates can be noisy if the measurements are highly volatile and become computationally expensive in high dimensions, as the number of samples or simulation replications needed to obtain a single estimate grows linearly with the parameter dimension. Moreover, finite-difference estimators are generally biased. In this section, we discuss the main “direct” stochastic gradient estimation techniques that provide unbiased estimators, specifically approaches based on perturbation analysis, the likelihood ratio method, and the method of weak derivatives. Many of these require just a single simulation replication to provide both estimates of the output performance and its gradient.

随机梯度估计方法旨在从随机模型中估计输出性能的梯度。我们关注的是期望值输出。具体来说，对于 SO 问题（2.4），我们希望估计Stochastic gradient estimation methods aim to estimate the gradient of an output performance from a stochastic model. We focus on outputs that are expected values. Specifically, for the SO problem (2.4), we wish to estimate

\[\begin{equation*} {\nabla _\theta } \mathbb{E}[Y(\theta ;\omega )] = \left( {{{\partial \mathbb{E}[Y(\theta ;\omega )]} \over {\partial {\theta _1}}}, \ldots ,{{\partial \mathbb{E}[Y(\theta ;\omega )]} \over {\partial {\theta _d}}}} \right). \end{equation*}\]

无穷小扰动分析（IPA）梯度，也称路径梯度，由 \({\nabla _\theta }Y(\theta ;\omega )\) 给出。在满足微分与积分可以交换的适当条件下，IPA 估计量是无偏的，即The infinitesimal perturbation analysis (IPA) or pathwise gradient is given by \({\nabla _\theta }Y(\theta ;\omega )\). Under appropriate conditions justifying the interchange of differentiation and integration, the IPA estimator is unbiased, i.e.,

\[\begin{equation*} \mathbb{E}[{\nabla _\theta }Y(\theta ;\omega )] = {\nabla _\theta } \mathbb{E}[Y(\theta ;\omega )]. \end{equation*}\]

无偏性所需的充分条件源自支配收敛定理的应用，对于IPA估计量来说，通常意味着性能函数\(Y( \cdot ;\omega )\)几乎处处必须是利普希茨连续的。当\(Y( \cdot ;\omega )\)不连续时，可以应用平滑扰动分析（SPA）通过对某些量进行条件化以平滑不连续性，从而导出无偏的梯度估计器。将随机性或样本路径\(\omega\)看作一系列\(m\)输入随机变量\(X = ({X_1}, \ldots ,{X_m})\)，我们将输出\(Y(X(\theta);\theta)\)重写为输入变量\(X\)的函数来代替对\(\omega\)的依赖（并且调换参数的顺序），IPA估计量由链式法则给出：Sufficient conditions required for unbiasedness stem from the application of the dominated convergence theorem, which for the IPA estimator generally means that the performance function \(Y( \cdot ;\omega )\) must be Lipschitz continuous almost surely. When \(Y( \cdot ;\omega )\) is discontinuous, smoothed perturbation analysis (SPA) can be applied to derive an unbiased gradient estimator by conditioning on certain quantities to smooth out the discontinuities. Viewing the randomness or sample path \(\omega\) as a sequence of \(m\) input random variables \(X = ({X_1}, \ldots ,{X_m})\), we rewrite the output \(Y(X(\theta);\theta)\) as a function of input variables \(X\) in place of the dependence on \(\omega\) (and reverse the order of the arguments), and the IPA estimator is given by the chain rule:

\[\begin{equation} \nabla_{\theta}Y(X;\theta) = \left. \sum\limits_{j = 1}^m {{{\partial Y(x;\theta )} \over {\partial {x_j}}}} \right|_{x = X} {{\partial {X_j}} \over {\partial \theta }} + {{\partial Y(X;\theta )} \over {\partial \theta }}, \end{equation}\]

随机变量导数 \({{\partial {X_j}} \over {\partial \theta }}\) 定义为where the random variable derivatives \({{\partial {X_j}} \over {\partial \theta }}\) are defined by

\[\begin{equation*} {{\partial {X_j}} \over {\partial \theta }} = - {{{{\partial F_j({X_j};\theta )} \over {\partial \theta }}} \over {f_j({X_j};\theta )}},\quad j = 1, \ldots ,m, \end{equation*}\]

其中 \({F_j}( \cdot ;\theta )\) 和 \({f_j}( \cdot ;\theta )\) 分别表示 \(X_j\) 的累积分布函数和概率密度函数。with \({F_j}( \cdot ;\theta )\) and \({f_j}( \cdot ;\theta )\) denoting the c.d.f. and p.d.f. of \(X_j\).

如前所述，为了使IPA估计器无偏，性能函数通常需要是利普希茨连续的。为了展示在哪种情况下会失败以及IPA估计器会有偏差，考虑输出性能函数\(Y=1\{ {X_1} + {X_2} \le 0\}\)。指示函数引入了一个不连续点，使得IPA估计器产生偏差。通过对\(X_2\)进行条件处理，可以应用SPA来处理这个不连续性，方法如下：As mentioned earlier, for the IPA estimator to be unbiased, the performance function generally needs to be Lipschitz continuous. To demonstrate where this fails and the IPA estimator is biased, consider the output performance function \(Y=1\{ {X_1} + {X_2} \le 0\}\). The indicator function introduces a discontinuity, making the IPA estimator biased. By conditioning on \(X_2\), SPA can be applied to address the discontinuity as follows:

\[\begin{align*} \nabla_{\theta} \mathbb{E}[Y(X_1,X_2;\theta)] & = {{\partial \mathbb{E}[\mathbb{E}[1\{ {X_1} + {X_2} \le 0\} |{X_2}]]} \over {\partial \theta }} = {{\partial \mathbb{E}[{F_1}( - {X_2};\theta )]} \over {\partial \theta }} \\ & = \mathbb{E} \left[ {{{\partial {F_1}( - {X_2};\theta )} \over {\partial \theta }} - {f_1}( - {X_2};\theta ){{\partial {X_2}} \over {\partial \theta }}} \right], \end{align*}\] 其中，第二个等号假设 \(X_1\) 与 \(X_2\) 相互独立。因此，无偏的 SPA 估计量为 \[\begin{equation*} {{\partial {F_1}( - {X_2};\theta )} \over {\partial \theta }} - {f_1}( - {X_2};\theta ){{\partial {X_2}} \over {\partial \theta }}. \end{equation*}\]。\[\begin{align*} \nabla_{\theta} \mathbb{E}[Y(X_1,X_2;\theta)] & = {{\partial \mathbb{E}[\mathbb{E}[1\{ {X_1} + {X_2} \le 0\} |{X_2}]]} \over {\partial \theta }} = {{\partial \mathbb{E}[{F_1}( - {X_2};\theta )]} \over {\partial \theta }} \\ & = \mathbb{E} \left[ {{{\partial {F_1}( - {X_2};\theta )} \over {\partial \theta }} - {f_1}( - {X_2};\theta ){{\partial {X_2}} \over {\partial \theta }}} \right], \end{align*}\] where the second equality assumes \(X_1\) is independent of \(X_2\), so that an unbiased SPA estimator is given by \[\begin{equation*} {{\partial {F_1}( - {X_2};\theta )} \over {\partial \theta }} - {f_1}( - {X_2};\theta ){{\partial {X_2}} \over {\partial \theta }}. \end{equation*}\]

更一般来说，SPA 是条件蒙特卡洛的一种应用，其中 IPA 估计量 \(dY/d\theta\) 是有偏的，通常是由于输出函数的形式或者系统的底层动力学导致的不连续性。通过选择一个合适的 \(X\)（这可能表示系统中的随机变量向量），SPA 估计量对条件期望 \(\mathbb{E}[Y|X]\) 进行求导。SPA 的成功取决于找到一个合适的 \(X\)，使得得到的条件期望导数 \(d\mathbb{E}[Y|X]/d\theta\) 足够平滑，从而无偏并且可以高效估计。More generally, SPA is an application of conditional Monte Carlo, where the IPA estimator \(dY/d\theta\) is biased, usually due to a discontinuity caused either by the form of the output function or from the underlying dynamics of the system. By selecting an appropriate \(X\), which could denote a vector of random variables in the system, the SPA estimator differentiates the conditional expectation \(\mathbb{E}[Y|X]\). The success of SPA depends on finding an appropriate \(X\) such that the resulting conditional expectation derivative \(d\mathbb{E}[Y|X]/d\theta\) is sufficiently smooth to be unbiased and can be efficiently estimated.

接下来考虑似然比（LR）方法，也称得分函数法。假设 \(X\) 的（联合）概率密度函数依赖参数 \(\theta\)，即 \(f(\cdot; \theta)\)，但 \(f\) 的支撑集（记为 \(\Omega\)）不依赖 \(\theta\)。Next we consider the likelihood ratio (LR) method, also known as the score function method. Suppose the (joint) p.d.f. of \(X\) depends on the parameter \(\theta\), i.e., \(f(\cdot; \theta)\), but the support of \(f\) denoted by \(\Omega\) does not depend on \(\theta\).

在满足微分与积分可以交换的适当条件下，\(\mathbb{E}[Y]\) 的梯度为Then the gradient of \(\mathbb{E}[Y]\) is given by (under appropriate conditions justifying the interchange of differentiation and integration)

\[\begin{align*} {\nabla _\theta }\mathbb{E}[Y(X)] & = {\nabla _\theta }\int_\Omega Y (x)f(x;\theta ){\mkern 1mu} dx = \int_\Omega Y (x){\nabla _\theta }f(x;\theta ){\mkern 1mu} dx \\ &= \int_\Omega Y (x){\nabla _\theta }\ln f(x;\theta )f(x;\theta ){\mkern 1mu} dx =\mathbb{E}[Y(X){\nabla _\theta }\ln f(X;\theta )], \end{align*}\]

所以 LR 梯度估计器是这样的so the LR gradient estimator is given by

\[\begin{equation} Y(X){\nabla _\theta }\ln f(X;\theta ). \end{equation}\]

因为参数 \(\theta\) 并未直接出现在 \(Y\) 中，即使 \(Y\) 表现不佳，例如 \(Y\) 是不连续的，LR 估计量 (2.10) 依然是无偏的。当参数 \(\theta\) 直接出现在 \(Y\) 中时，如果能找到合适的变量变换，可以应用一种叫做推出 LR（push-out LR）的方法。我们用最简单的例子来说明：考虑输出 \(Y=1\{ {X_1} + \theta \le 0\}\)，LR 无法直接应用（IPA 也不行，因为函数是不连续的）。通过变量变换 \({X_2} = {X_1} + \theta\)，新随机变量 \({X_2}\) 的密度为 \({f_2}(x - \theta ;\theta )\)。然后，LR 方法可以应用于新的输出函数 \(Y = 1\{ {X_2} \le 0\}\)，因为参数 \(\theta\) 已经从原始输出函数 \(Y\) 中被推出，并进入了输入密度。Because the parameter \(\theta\) does not directly appear in \(Y\), the LR estimator (2.10) will be unbiased even if \(Y\) is not well behaved, e.g., if \(Y\) is discontinuous. When the parameter \(\theta\) appears directly in \(Y\), a method called push-out LR can be applied if a suitable change of variables can be found. We illustrate with the simplest example: Consider the output \(Y=1\{ {X_1} + \theta \le 0\}\), for which LR cannot be directly applied (nor IPA, since the function is discontinuous). By a change of variable \({X_2} = {X_1} + \theta\), the density of the new random variable \({X_2}\) is \({f_2}(x - \theta ;\theta )\). Then the LR method can be applied to the new output function \(Y = 1\{ {X_2} \le 0\}\), as the parameter \(\theta\) has been pushed out of the original output function \(Y\) and into the input density.

如果 \(\theta\) 同时出现在输入分布和输出性能中，并且两者都表现得足够良好，那么可以使用组合 IPA/LR 估计器，它只需将由 (2.9) 和 (2.10) 给出的两个估计器相加即可。然而，如果情况不是这样，比如输出函数或输入密度对于参数是不连续的（或者支持区域依赖于参数），那么就必须使用其他方法，比如前面讨论的 SPA 方法，或者广义似然比（GLR）方法，GLR 方法是组合 IPA/LR 估计器的扩展，也可以被视为推导 LR 方法的广义版本。GLR 方法假设输出函数的形式如下：\[Y = \varphi (g(X;\theta )),\]，其中 \(g\) 是一个二阶可微函数的 \(m\) 维向量，而 \(\varphi\) 是一个可测函数，不一定连续。If \(\theta\) appears in both the input distribution and the output performance, where both are sufficiently well behaved, then a combined IPA/LR estimator can be used, which would simply add the two estimators given by (2.9) and (2.10). However, in the case where this is not the case, e.g., either the output function or input density is discontinuous with respect to the parameter (or the support depends on the parameters), then other methods must be used, such as SPA discussed earlier or the generalized likelihood ratio (GLR) method, which is an extension of the combined IPA/LR estimator and can also be viewed as a generalized version of the push-out LR method. The GLR method assumes an output function of the following form: \[Y = \varphi (g(X;\theta )),\] where \(g\) is an \(m\)-dimensional vector of twice-differentiable functions and \(\varphi\) is a measurable function that is not necessarily continuous.

那么 GLR 估计量就是 LR 估计量的以下扩展：Then the GLR estimator is the following extension of the LR estimator:

\[\begin{equation} \varphi (g(X;\theta )) \left( {\nabla _\theta }\ln f(X;\theta ) + d(X;\theta) \right), \end{equation}\]

\[\begin{eqnarray*} d(x;\theta) &=& \sum\limits_{i = 1}^m {e_i^T} {J_g^{-1}}(x;\theta) \left( \frac{\partial {J_g}(x;\theta )}{\partial {x_i}} \right) J_g^{-1}(x;\theta) \frac{\partial g(x;\theta )}{\partial \theta } \\ & & \hspace{-40pt} - {\rm trace} \left( J_g^{-1}(x;\theta )\frac{\partial J_g(x;\theta )}{\partial {\theta}} \right) -{\left[ {{J_g^{-1}}{{(x;\theta )}}{{\partial g(x;\theta )} \over {\partial \theta }}} \right]^T} {\nabla_x }\ln f(x;\theta), \\ & & {{\partial g(x;\theta )} \over {\partial \theta }} = {\left( {{{\partial {g_1}(x;\theta )} \over {\partial \theta }},{{\partial {g_2}(x;\theta )} \over {\partial \theta }},...,{{\partial {g_m}(x;\theta )} \over {\partial \theta }}} \right)^T}, \end{eqnarray*}\]

其中，\({J_g}(x;\theta )\) 表示向量 \(g\) 关于向量 \(x\) 的 \(m \times m\) 雅可比矩阵，\(e_i\) 表示第 \(i\) 个方向的单位向量，\({{\partial {J_g}(x;\theta )} \over {\partial z}}\) 表示将 \({J_g}(x;\theta )\) 的每个元素分别对 \(z\) 求导后得到的矩阵。where \({J_g}(x;\theta )\) denotes the \(m \times m\) Jacobian matrix of vector \(g\) with respect to the vector \(x\), \(e_i\) represents the unit vector in the \(i\)-th direction, and \({{\partial {J_g}(x;\theta )} \over {\partial z}}\) denotes the matrix obtained by differentiating each element of \({J_g}(x;\theta )\) with respect to \(z\) individually.

我们考虑的最后一种随机梯度估计方法是弱导数（WD）方法，也称为测度值微分，其设置与LR方法相同，即（联合）输入概率密度函数为\(f(\cdot; \theta)\)，且\(f\)的支撑不依赖于\(\theta\)。同样地，沿用了在推导LR估计器时采用的第一步，即在期望内传递梯度算子（在适当条件下可以将微分与积分互换）：The final stochastic gradient estimation approach we consider is the method of weak derivatives (WD), also known as measure-valued differentiation, where the setting is the same as that of the LR method, i.e., with (joint) input p.d.f. \(f(\cdot; \theta)\) and the support of \(f\) not depending on \(\theta\). Again following the first steps used in deriving the LR estimator by passing the gradient operator inside the expectation (under appropriate conditions justifying the interchange of differentiation and integration):

\[\begin{align*} {\nabla _\theta }\mathbb{E}[Y(X)] & = {\nabla _\theta }\int_\Omega Y (x)f(x;\theta ){\mkern 1mu} dx = \int_\Omega Y (x){\nabla _\theta }f(x;\theta ){\mkern 1mu} dx \\ &= \int_\Omega Y (x){c(\theta)[f^{(+)}(x;\theta) - f^{(-)}(x;\theta)] } dx \\ & = c(\theta) \mathbb{E}[Y(X^{(+)})-Y(X^{(-)})], ~~X^{(\pm)} \sim f^{(\pm)}(\cdot; \theta), \end{align*}\]

其中，\(f^{(\pm)}\) 为（联合）概率密度函数，三元组 \((c(\theta), f^{(+)}(\cdot; \theta), f^{(-)}(\cdot; \theta))\) 称为弱导数。弱导数总是存在（例如，可利用 Hahn–Jordan 分解），但并不唯一，实际上存在无穷多个弱导数。于是，WD 梯度估计量为where \(f^{(\pm)}\) are (joint) p.d.f.(s) and the triplet \((c(\theta), f^{(+)}(\cdot; \theta), f^{(-)}(\cdot; \theta))\) is called the weak derivative, which always exists (e.g., Hahn-Jordan decomposition) but is not unique; in fact, there are an infinite number of weak derivatives. Then the WD gradient estimator is given by

\[\begin{equation} c(\theta) [Y(X^{(+)})-Y(X^{(-)})]. \end{equation}\]

同样，由于参数 \(\theta\) 并未直接出现在 \(Y\) 中，即使 \(Y\) 不具有良好的性质，例如 \(Y\) 不连续，WD 估计量（2.12）仍然是无偏的。Again, because the parameter \(\theta\) does not directly appear in \(Y\), the WD estimator (2.12) will be unbiased even if \(Y\) is not well behaved, e.g., if \(Y\) is discontinuous.

我们用一个简单的排队示例结束本节，以说明 IPA、LR 和 WD 估计器。We conclude this section with a simple queueing example to illustrate the IPA, LR, and WD estimators.

单服务台排队示例Single-Server Queue Example

考虑一个单服务台排队系统，其中 \({A_i}\) 表示第 \((i\)−\(1)\) 位顾客与第 \(i\) 位顾客之间的到达间隔时间，\(X_i\) 是第 \(i\) 位顾客的服务时间。我们关注的输出性能是 \(Y_i\)，即第 \(i\) 位顾客的系统逗留时间，包括排队时间和服务时间。Consider a single-server queue, where \({A_i}\) denotes the interarrival time between the \((i\)-\(1)\)th and \(i\)th customers and \(X_i\) is the service time of the \(i\)th customer. The output performance of interest is \(Y_i\), the system time of the \(i\)th customer, comprising both queueing and service time.

假设系统初始为空，并按先到先服务（FCFS）规则运行，则前 \(N\) 位顾客的服务完成时间完全由其到达时间和服务时长决定，顾客的系统逗留时间满足递归的 Lindley 方程：Assume the system starts empty and operates under the first-come, first-served (FCFS) queue discipline, the completion times of the first \(N\) customers are determined solely by their arrival times and service durations, and the system time of a customer satisfies the recursive Lindley equation:

\[\begin{equation*} {Y_{i + 1}} = {X_{i + 1}} + ({Y_i} - {A_{i + 1}})^+. \end{equation*}\]

此外，假设到达过程与服务时间相互独立，而服务时间本身也是相互独立的，但不一定服从相同分布，对 \(X_i\) 的概率密度函数和累积分布函数分别为 \(f_i\) 和 \(F_i\)。如果 \(\theta\) 是服务时间分布中的一个参数，那么 IPA 估计量可以通过对上述 Lindley 方程关于 \(\theta\) 求导来得到：Furthermore, assume the arrival process is independent of the service times, which themselves are mutually independent but not necessarily identically distributed, with p.d.f. and c.d.f. for \(X_i\) given by \(f_i\) and \(F_i\), respectively. If \(\theta\) is a parameter within the service time distribution(s), then the IPA estimator can be derived by differentiating the above Lindley equation with respect to \(\theta\):

\[\begin{equation} {{d{Y_{i + 1}}} \over {d\theta }} = {{d{X_{i + 1}}} \over {d\theta }} + {{d{Y_i}} \over {d\theta }} \cdot {\bf{1}}\{ {Y_i} \ge {A_{i + 1}}\}. \end{equation}\]

将前 \(N\) 位顾客的平均系统逗留时间记为 \(\bar{Y}_N = {1 \over N}\sum\limits_{i = 1}^N {{Y_i}},\)，则其导数的 IPA 估计量为For the average system time over the first \(N\) customers denoted by \(\bar{Y}_N = {1 \over N}\sum\limits_{i = 1}^N {{Y_i}},\) the IPA estimator for the derivative of the average system time is given by

\[\begin{equation} \nabla_{\theta} \bar{Y}_N = {1 \over N}\sum\limits_{i = 1}^N {{{d{Y_i}} \over {d\theta }}} = {1 \over N}\sum\limits_{m = 1}^M {\sum\limits_{i = {n_{m - 1}} + 1}^{{n_m}} {\sum\limits_{j = {n_{m - 1}} + 1}^i {{{d{X_j}} \over {d\theta }}} } } , \end{equation}\]，其中\(M\)表示观察到的忙时数量，\(n_m\)代表在第\(m\)个忙时中最后服务的顾客的索引（\({n_0} = {\rm{ }}0\)和\({n_M}{\rm{ }} = {\rm{ }}N\)用于\(M\)个完整的忙时）。实现这个IPA估计器需要维护两个正在进行的量：一个对应于公式(2.13)，另一个用于公式(2.14)中的求和。因此，额外的计算开销很小，而且不需要对底层模拟进行任何修改。\[\begin{equation} \nabla_{\theta} \bar{Y}_N = {1 \over N}\sum\limits_{i = 1}^N {{{d{Y_i}} \over {d\theta }}} = {1 \over N}\sum\limits_{m = 1}^M {\sum\limits_{i = {n_{m - 1}} + 1}^{{n_m}} {\sum\limits_{j = {n_{m - 1}} + 1}^i {{{d{X_j}} \over {d\theta }}} } } , \end{equation}\] where \(M\) denotes the number of observed busy periods, and \(n_m\) represents the index of the last customer served in the \(m\)-th busy period (with \({n_0} = {\rm{ }}0\) and \({n_M}{\rm{ }} = {\rm{ }}N\) for \(M\) complete busy periods). The implementation of this IPA estimator requires maintaining two ongoing quantities: one corresponding to Equation (2.13) and another for the summation in Equation (2.14). Therefore, the additional computational overhead is minimal, and no modifications to the underlying simulation are necessary.

同样，假设到达间隔时间与服务时间独立生成，则输入随机变量的联合概率密度函数是到达时间分布的密度与各服务时间分布密度的乘积，即Again, assuming the interarrival times and service times are independently generated, the joint p.d.f. of the input random variables is the product of the p.d.f of the arrival time distribution and the individual service time distributions, given by

\[\begin{equation*} g({A_1}, \ldots ,{A_N})\prod\limits_{i = 1}^N {{f_i}} ({X_i};\theta ), \end{equation*}\]，其中\(g\)表示到达时间的联合概率密度函数。由于\(g\)不依赖于\(\theta\)，所以LR梯度估计器为\[\begin{equation*} g({A_1}, \ldots ,{A_N})\prod\limits_{i = 1}^N {{f_i}} ({X_i};\theta ), \end{equation*}\] where \(g\) represents the joint p.d.f. of the arrival times. Since \(g\) doesn’t depend on \(\theta\), the LR gradient estimator is given by

\[\begin{equation*} \left. \nabla_{\theta} \bar{Y}_N \right|_{{\rm{LR}}} = \bar{Y}_N \sum\limits_{i = 1}^N {{{\partial \ln {f_i({X_i};\theta )}} \over {\partial \theta }}} . \end{equation*}\]

类似地，应用微分的乘积法则可以推导出 WD 梯度估计器：The WD gradient estimator is similarly derived by applying the product rule of differentiation:

\[\begin{eqnarray*} \left. \nabla_{\theta} \bar{Y}_N \right|_{{\rm{WD}}} &=& \sum\limits_{i = 1}^N {{c_i}} (\theta )\left[ {\bar{Y}_N}({A_1}, \ldots ,{A_N}, X_1, \ldots , X_i^{( + )}, \ldots , X_N) \right. \\ & & \left. ~~~~~~~~~~- {\bar{Y}_N}({A_1}, \ldots ,{A_N}, X_1, \ldots ,X_i^{( - )}, \ldots , X_N) \right], \end{eqnarray*}\] 其中 \(X_i^{(\pm)}\sim f_i^{(\pm)}\) 对 \(i = 1, \ldots ,N\)，而 \(({c_i}(\theta),f_i^{(+)},f_i^{(-)})\) 是 \({f_i}\) 的弱导数。需要注意的是，一般来说，估计器的实现需要 \({2^N}\) 条不同的样本路径以及相应的样本性能估计，每当参数 \(\theta\) 出现在 \(N\) 个输入随机变量中时。不过，可以使用随机化来减少所需的样本路径数量。\[\begin{eqnarray*} \left. \nabla_{\theta} \bar{Y}_N \right|_{{\rm{WD}}} &=& \sum\limits_{i = 1}^N {{c_i}} (\theta )\left[ {\bar{Y}_N}({A_1}, \ldots ,{A_N}, X_1, \ldots , X_i^{( + )}, \ldots , X_N) \right. \\ & & \left. ~~~~~~~~~~- {\bar{Y}_N}({A_1}, \ldots ,{A_N}, X_1, \ldots ,X_i^{( - )}, \ldots , X_N) \right], \end{eqnarray*}\] where \(X_i^{(\pm)}\sim f_i^{(\pm)}\) for \(i = 1, \ldots ,N\), and \(({c_i}(\theta),f_i^{(+)},f_i^{(-)})\) is a weak derivative for \({f_i}\). It is important to note that in general the implementation of the estimator requires \({2^N}\) distinct sample paths and corresponding sample performance estimates whenever the parameter \(\theta\) appears in \(N\) input random variables. However, randomization can be used to reduce the number of required sample paths.

2.6 方差缩减技术2.6 Variance Reduction Techniques

方差缩减技术可以提高从随机仿真模型中估计的计算效率，在最好的情况下，可以带来数量级的提升。不过，在使用这些技术时需要小心，因为性能下降也是可能的，除了条件蒙特卡洛方法，它可以保证不会变得更差。我们在本章的最后简要总结了一些最常用的方法：对立变量、控制变量、间接估计、条件蒙特卡洛、重要性抽样、分裂、分层抽样、准蒙特卡洛方法和公共随机数。公共随机数与其他方法不同，因为它用于比较两个不同仿真模型的输出，而其他方法则是为了提高单个仿真模型输出估计的精度。 普通的随机数通常可以与任何其他随机数一起使用，而这些随机数有时也可以组合使用。Variance reduction techniques enhance the computational efficiency of estimation from a stochastic simulation model, in the best cases leading to orders of magnitude improvements. However, care must be taken in their application, because degradation of performance is also possible, except for the use of conditional Monte Carlo, which guarantees that one can do no worse. We end this chapter by briefly summarizing some of the most widely used approaches: antithetic variates, control variates, indirect estimation, conditional Monte Carlo, importance sampling, splitting, stratified sampling, the quasi-Monte Carlo method, and common random numbers. Common random numbers differs from the others in that it addresses comparison between outputs of two different simulation models, whereas the others aim at increasing precision of output estimates from a single simulation model. Common random numbers can generally be used in conjunction with any of the others, which themselves may sometimes also be combined.

对于每种方差缩减技术，我们提供了主要思路和一个（或两个）示例，这些示例基于上一节使用的 FCFS 单服务台排队系统，其中 \(\bar{Y}_N\) 表示关注的输出随机变量（\(N\) 个顾客的平均系统时间），由到达时间和服务时间输入随机变量 \(\{A_i, X_i\}\) 生成。否则，\(Y\) 表示“通用”输出随机变量，且上标“(\(i\))”表示任何随机变量的第 \(i\) 次仿真重复。For each of the variance reduction techniques, we provide the main idea and an example (or two) based on the FCFS single-server queue used in the previous section, where \(\bar{Y}_N\) will denote the output random variable of interest (average system time over \(N\) customers), generated by interarrival time and service time input random variables \(\{A_i, X_i\}\). Otherwise, \(Y\) denotes the “generic” output random variable, and the superscript “(\(i\))” denotes the \(i\)th simulation replication for any random variable.

  • 对立变量
    (i) 主要思想：通过使用成对的仿真重复（通常通过随机数）来利用引入的负相关性，基于以下基本关系：\[{\rm{Var}}\left( Y + Y' \right) = {\rm{Var}} Y + {\rm{Var}} Y' + 2 {\rm{Cov}} (Y,Y'),\]，如果\(Y\)和\(Y'\)呈负相关，则右边小于各自方差之和。
    (ii) 示例：将随机数\(U\)和\(1-U\)成对用于输入，其中\(U \sim U(0,1)\)，而不是独立同分布的\(U\)和\(U'\)。如果\(\bar{Y}_N\)是输入随机变量的单调函数——就像平均系统时间作为到达时间间隔和服务时间的函数可能预期的那样——那么使用这些对立变量计算的成对平均值\((\bar{Y}_N^{(1)} + \bar{Y}_N^{(2)})/2\)预计其方差会低于使用两个独立重复的情况，因为\[{\rm{Var}}\left( \bar{Y}_N^{(1)} + \bar{Y}_N^{(2)} \right) < {\rm{Var}} \bar{Y}_N^{(1)} + {\rm{Var}} \bar{Y}_N^{(2)} \mbox{~if~} {\rm{Cov}}\left( \bar{Y}_N^{(1)}, \bar{Y}_N^{(2)} \right) <0.\]
    (iii) 实用性：与大多数其他方差缩减技术相比最小，但实现起来很简单。    Antithetic Variates
    (i) Main idea: Exploit induced negative correlation by using pairs of simulation replications, generally via the random numbers, based on the following basic relationship: \[{\rm{Var}}\left( Y + Y' \right) = {\rm{Var}} Y + {\rm{Var}} Y' + 2 {\rm{Cov}} (Y,Y'),\] where the righthand side is less than the sum of the individual variances if \(Y\) and \(Y'\) are negatively correlated.
    (ii) Example: Use random numbers \(U\) and \(1-U\) for the inputs in pairs, where \(U \sim U(0,1)\), rather than i.i.d. \(U\) and \(U'\). If \(\bar{Y}_N\) is a monotone function of the input random variables – as might be expected for average system time as a function of interarrival times and service times, then the paired average \((\bar{Y}_N^{(1)} + \bar{Y}_N^{(2)})/2\) using these antithetic variates is expected to have lower variance than if two independent replications were used, since \[{\rm{Var}}\left( \bar{Y}_N^{(1)} + \bar{Y}_N^{(2)} \right) < {\rm{Var}} \bar{Y}_N^{(1)} + {\rm{Var}} \bar{Y}_N^{(2)} \mbox{~if~} {\rm{Cov}}\left( \bar{Y}_N^{(1)}, \bar{Y}_N^{(2)} \right) <0.\]
    (iii) Practical utility: Minimal compared to most other variance reduction techniques but easy to implement.

  • 控制变量法
    （i）基本思想：利用目标输出随机变量 \(Y\)（其均值未知）与另一个系统随机变量 \(Z\) 之间的强相关性，后者具有已知均值 \(\mathbb{E}[Z]\)。新的控制变量估计量为 \[Y - \lambda (Z -\mathbb{E}[Z]),\]。可以看出，该估计量是无偏的，方差为 \[{\rm{Var}}~Y + \lambda^2 {\rm{Var}}~Z -2\lambda {\rm{Cov}}(Y,Z).\]。适当地选择 \(\lambda\) 可以降低方差，理论最优选择为 \(\lambda ^* = {{\rm{Cov}}(Y,Z)}/{\rm{Var}}~Z\)，对应的最小方差为 \({\rm{Var}}~Y - {{{[{\rm{Cov}}(Y,Z)}]^2}} / {{\rm{Var}}~Z}\)。若有多个随机变量与 \(Y\) 相关，可以将它们的线性组合作为控制变量。
    （ii）示例：在排队系统中，尤其是先到先服务的单服务台排队系统中，系统逗留时间与服务时间应具有较强的正相关性，因此 \(\lambda\) 应为正。在服务时间具有共同均值 \(\mathbb{E}[X]\) 的情况下，以平均服务时间为控制变量的估计量为 \[\bar{Y}_N - \lambda (\bar{X}_N -\mathbb{E}[X]).\]。其他直观的控制变量还包括到达率和系统或服务台的利用率。一种不太直观的选择是稳态平均系统逗留时间：若到达过程为泊松过程，该均值可能已知，但要为这个已知量构造无偏估计量，仍需谨慎。
    金融领域的一个例子是：\(Y\) 可以是没有解析期望表达式的美式看涨期权收益，\(Z\) 则可以是具有已知解析期望的欧式看涨期权收益。由于 \(Y\) 与 \(Z\) 正相关（二者均依赖标的资产价格），\(Z\) 可作为有效的控制变量。
    （iii）实际用途：该方法可能非常有效，但高度依赖具体问题，因为需要找到一个相关性强、且相关关系得到充分理解的控制变量。理论最优值 \(\lambda^*\) 依赖通常未知的 \({\rm{Cov}}(Y,Z)\)，以及也可能未知的 \({\rm{Var}}~Z\)，这一点说明了上述要求。特别地，如果所选控制变量与目标变量相互独立，则对任何非零的 \(\lambda\)，控制变量估计量的方差反而更大。    Control Variates
    (i) Main idea: Exploit strong correlation between the output random variable of interest \(Y\) (which has unknown mean) and another system random variable \(Z\) with known mean \(\mathbb{E}[Z]\), with the new control variate estimator given by \[Y - \lambda (Z -\mathbb{E}[Z]),\] which can be seen to be unbiased with variance \[{\rm{Var}}~Y + \lambda^2 {\rm{Var}}~Z -2\lambda {\rm{Cov}}(Y,Z).\] An appropriate choice of \(\lambda\) results in variance reduction, and the theoretically optimal choice is \(\lambda ^* = {{\rm{Cov}}(Y,Z)}/{\rm{Var}}~Z\) with the corresponding minimal variance \({\rm{Var}}~Y - {{{[{\rm{Cov}}(Y,Z)}]^2}} / {{\rm{Var}}~Z}\). For multiple random variables correlated with \(Y\), linear combinations can be used as control variates.
    (ii) Examples: System times and service times should be highly positively correlated in a queueing system and especially for the FCFS single-server queue, so that \(\lambda\) would be positive. Under the scenario where the service times have a common mean \(\mathbb{E}[X]\), the control variate estimator using average service time as a control variate would be \[\bar{Y}_N - \lambda (\bar{X}_N -\mathbb{E}[X]).\] Other obvious possible control variates include the arrival rate and the system/server utilization. A less obvious control variate would be using the steady-state mean system time, which would be known if the arrival process were Poisson, but then finding an unbiased estimator for this known quantity would require care.
    An example from finance: \(Y\) could be the payoff of an American call option with no analytical expectation, while \(Z\) could be the payoff of a European call option with a known analytical expectation. Since \(Y\) and \(Z\) are positively correlated (both depend on the underlying asset price), \(Z\) serves as an effective control variate.
    (iii) Practical utility: Can be highly effective but very problem dependent, as it relies on finding a good control variate such that the correlation is both strong and well understood, as indicated by the theoretically optimal value of \(\lambda^*\) depending on \({\rm{Cov}}(Y,Z)\), which is generally unknown, and \({\rm{Var}}~Z\), which may also be unknown. In particular, if the control variate chosen is independent, then the control variate estimator would have higher variance for any nonzero \(\lambda\).

  • 间接估计
    (i) 主要思想：利用感兴趣的输出随机变量与另一个系统随机变量之间已知的关系。 (ii) 示例：对于排队系统使用利特尔法则，它将系统中人数过程的时间平均与客户平均系统时间联系起来。按照适当方向操作会降低方差，但反过来不行，而且还取决于到达率是否已知或也必须估计。
    (iii) 实用性：通常比大多数其他技术更依赖具体问题或领域。    Indirect Estimation
    (i) Main idea: Exploit known relationship between the output random variable of interest and another system random variable. (ii) Example: Using Little’s Law for a queueing system, which relates the time average of the number-in-system process to the customer average system time. Going in the appropriate direction will decrease variance, but not vice versa, and it also depends on whether or not the arrival rate is known or must also be estimated.
    (iii) Practical utility: Generally even more problem or domain dependent than most of the other techniques.

  • 条件蒙特卡洛
    (i) 主要思路：对系统模型中的一个或多个其他随机变量进行条件化。通过方差分解关系保证不会比原始估计器差：\[\begin{equation*} {\rm{Var}}~Y = \mathbb{E}[{\rm{Var}}[Y|X]] + {\rm{Var}}[\mathbb{E}[Y|X]] \ge {\rm{Var}}[\mathbb{E}[Y|X]]. \end{equation*}\] (ii) 示例：要估计 FCFS 单服务台排队系统中的系统平均时间，可以对队列中的客户数量（如果有的话）进行条件化，比如 \(N_q\)，以及正在服务的客户剩余服务时间（如果有的话），比如 \(S_r\)，其条件蒙特卡洛估计器可以表示为 \[S_r + N_q \mathbb{E}[X].\]。如果服务时间是指数分布，一个方差更低的估计器只需取每位到达客户看到的系统中人数，再乘以平均服务时间 \(\mathbb{E}[X]\)。 (iii) 实用性：方法可能非常有效，但非常依赖具体问题，因为它依赖于找到适当的随机变量进行条件化，从而得到可以通过模拟轻松估计的条件期望量。    Conditional Monte Carlo
    (i) Main idea: Condition on one or more other random variables in the system model. Guaranteed to do no worse than the original estimator by the variance decomposition relationship: \[\begin{equation*} {\rm{Var}}~Y = \mathbb{E}[{\rm{Var}}[Y|X]] + {\rm{Var}}[\mathbb{E}[Y|X]] \ge {\rm{Var}}[\mathbb{E}[Y|X]]. \end{equation*}\] (ii) Example: To estimate the expected system time in the FCFS single-server queue, condition on the number of customers in queue (if any), say \(N_q\), and the remaining service time of the customer in service (if any), say \(S_r\), for which the conditional MC estimator would be given by \[S_r + N_q \mathbb{E}[X].\] If the service times were exponential, an even lower variance estimator would simply take the number in system that each arriving customer sees and multiply that by the mean service time \(\mathbb{E}[X]\). (iii) Practical utility: Can be highly effective but very problem dependent, as it relies on finding appropriate random variables on which to condition that leads to a conditional expectation quantity that can be easily estimated from the simulation.

  • 重要性采样
    （i）基本思想：改变底层输入分布，再利用与输入分布有关的似然比，对输出估计量进行相应的重新加权。
    （ii）示例：若关注的输出是系统内顾客数量达到某个巨大值的概率，增加这一事件发生频率的直观方式是提高到达率或延长服务时间，这就是重要性采样在排队系统中的一种实现方式。
    （iii）实际用途：该技术最适用于稀有事件仿真。当某事件在仿真中极少发生时，输出几乎总是 0；由于输出显然不服从正态分布，此时得到的置信区间可能具有误导性。通过再次利用似然比，该技术还可以从原仿真设置出发，生成对应不同输入设置的多条样本路径（仿真重复）。因为能够重复利用同一条样本路径，这种应用有时被称为“绿色仿真”。    Importance Sampling
    (i) Main idea: Change the underlying input distribution(s) and then reweight the output estimator accordingly by the likelihood ratio related to the input distributions.
    (ii) Example: If the output of interest is the probability of the system reaching a huge number of customers in the system, then the obvious way to increase the frequency of this occurring is to increase the arrival rate or the service time, which is how importance sampling could be implemented in a queueing system.
    (iii) Practical utility: Most useful in rare event simulation when an event is unlikely to occur in a simulation, so that the output may return 0 almost all of the time, giving deceptive confidence intervals, since the output is obviously not normal. This technique can also be used to generate multiple sample paths (simulation replications) at different input settings from the original simulation settings, again by using the likelihood ratio, and this application is sometimes known as “green simulation” for its reuse of the single sample path.

  • 拆分
    (i) 主要思想：根据某些标准有选择地修剪或拆分样本路径（仿真重复），其理念是那些被修剪的路径不太可能对所需输出有贡献，而需要拆分的路径则更有希望。何时以及如何进行拆分是关键，已经提出了许多方法。
    (ii) 示例：使用与重要性抽样相同的示例，其中感兴趣的输出是系统达到大量客户的概率，那么直观上，拆分应发生在高度拥堵、很可能达到系统大数的样本路径上，而系统为空的路径可能会被修剪。
    (iii) 实用价值：像重要性抽样一样，这种技术在罕见事件模拟中很有用，有时也被视为重要性抽样的一种双重或补充方法。    Splitting
    (i) Main idea: Selectively prune or split sample paths (simulation replications) according to some criteria, with the idea that pruned paths are not likely to contribute to the desired output, whereas the paths to be split are more promising. When and how to carry out the splitting is the key, and many procedures have been proposed.
    (ii) Example: Using the same example as for importance sampling, where the output of interest is the probability of the system reaching a huge number of customers in the system, then intuitively splitting should occur for highly congested sample paths that are more likely to reach the large number in system, whereas paths in which the system is empty might be pruned.
    (iii) Practical utility: Like importance sampling, this technique can be useful in rare event simulation, and is sometimes viewed as a type of dual or complementary approach to importance sampling.

  • 分层采样
    （i）基本思想：将样本路径（仿真重复）划分为若干组，使各组内部的变异相对较小，从而降低总体方差。
    （ii）示例：考虑先到先服务的单服务台排队系统，初始系统人数（状态）服从某个分布，例如以相同概率取 0 或 1。与其从该初始分布中随机采样，再对全部仿真重复取平均，不如将总仿真重复次数平分给这两个初始状态，分别计算各组（初始状态为 0 或 1）的平均值，再赋予相同权重计算最终总体平均值。从某种意义上说，这一例子可以看作条件蒙特卡洛与下文将介绍的拟蒙特卡洛的结合：它以初始状态为条件，而初始状态按确定性方式分配，不再随机抽样。
    （iii）实际用途：如果能够找到良好的分层方式，该方法就可能有效；能否做到这一点同样高度依赖具体问题。    Stratified Sampling
    (i) Main idea: Partition sample paths (simulation replications) into groups such that the variation within each group is relatively small, thus reducing the overall variance.
    (ii) Example: Consider the FCFS single-server queue with a distribution on the initial number in system (state), e.g., 0 or 1 with equal probability. Rather than randomly sampling from this initial distribution and averaging over all replications, one could divide the total number of replications into half for each of the two initial states, and average within each set of replications (initial state 0 or state 1) and then give equal weight to compute the final overall average. In some ways, this particular example could be viewed as combining conditional Monte Carlo and quasi-Monte Carlo (to be described next), as it uses conditioning on the initial state, which is deterministically distributed rather than randomly sampled.
    (iii) Practical utility: When a good stratification is available – again very problem dependent, this approach can be effective.

  • 拟蒙特卡洛
    （i）基本思想：不使用独立同分布的 \(U(0,1)\) 随机数，而是以确定性方式生成“低差异”序列，即适当地安排采样点的位置。
    （ii）示例：将生成到达间隔时间序列与服务时间序列的随机数生成器，分别替换为两条不同的拟蒙特卡洛数流，每个过程各用一条。
    （iii）实际用途：该方法对低维问题有效；但除非采用随机化形式，生成彼此独立、且各自基于一次拟蒙特卡洛仿真的重复，否则不能为输出构造置信区间。当输出性能指标不连续时，也可能遇到问题。    Quasi-Monte Carlo
    (i) Main idea: Rather than using i.i.d. \(U(0,1)\) random numbers, the goal is to generate “low-discrepancy” sequences deterministically, i.e., to space the points appropriately.
    (ii) Example: Replace the random number generators producing the two interarrival and service time sequences with a separate quasi-MC stream for each of the two processes.
    (iii) Practical utility: Effective for low-dimensional problems, but does not provide confidence intervals for the output without using the randomized form to generate independent replications, each based on a quasi-MC simulation. May also have problems with discontinuous output performance measures.

  • 公共随机数
    （i）基本思想：在比较不同系统时，尽量让对应过程使用相同的随机性，以使对应输出随机变量之间产生正相关，尤其是降低两个均值之差的估计量的方差。这里仍然利用前面对偶变量法中的基本关系，只是将求和改为求差：\[\begin{equation*} {\rm{Var}}(Y_A - Y_B) = {\rm{Var}}~Y_A + {\rm{Var}}~Y_B - 2{\rm{Cov}}(Y_A,Y_B), \end{equation*}\]，其中 \(Y_A\) 和 \(Y_B\) 分别表示系统 A 与 B 的输出。若差值的置信区间不包含 0，则可以认为两个系统之间的性能差异在统计上显著。
    （ii）示例：对于先到先服务的单服务台排队系统，若要比较服务时间分布不同、但服务时间均值和到达过程相同的两个系统，可以为服务时间单独使用一条随机数流，并让到达过程使用完全相同的到达间隔时间，从而对到达过程实现完全耦合。在这种设置下，公共随机数应当有良好效果。
    （iii）实际用途：如果实现正确，这是一项特别有效的技术，但效果仍可能高度依赖具体问题。实现被比较系统之间正相关的关键在于同步。一般而言，需要为一个系统中的不同过程分配不同的随机数生成器，这样在比较多个系统时，各对应过程就可以使用相同的随机数流，提高产生正相关的可能性。    Common Random Numbers
    (i) Main idea: Try to use the same randomness for the same processes in different systems being compared, to induce positive correlation between the corresponding output random variables, specifically reducing the variance of the difference estimator between the two means, again based on the basic relationship used earlier for antithetic variates, expressed now as a difference rather than a sum: \[\begin{equation*} {\rm{Var}}(Y_A - Y_B) = {\rm{Var}}~Y_A + {\rm{Var}}~Y_B - 2{\rm{Cov}}(Y_A,Y_B), \end{equation*}\] where \(Y_A\) and \(Y_B\) denote the output for two different systems A and B, respectively. A confidence interval for the difference would be interpreted as there being a statistically significant difference in performance between the two systems if it did not contain 0.
    (ii) Example: For the FCFS single-server queue, if we wish to compare two systems with different service time distributions but the same mean and arrival process, then common random numbers should work well by using a separate stream of random numbers for the service times and the exact same interarrival times for the arrival process, allowing perfect coupling for that process.
    (iii) Practical utility: If implemented correctly, this is a particularly effective technique, but again its success can be very problem dependent. The concept of synchronization is the key to achieving positive correlation between systems being compared. Generally, this means assigning different random number generators to different processes in a system, so that when comparing multiple systems, the corresponding processes could use the same stream of random numbers to increase the likelihood of inducing positive correlation.

2.8 面向仿真与优化的工业 AI 智能体2.8 Industrial AI Agents for Simulation and Optimization

前面章节回顾的方法——随机仿真、随机优化、马尔可夫决策过程和基于梯度的学习——为新型智能工业系统提供了算法基础。在这样的系统中，模拟不仅仅是离线分析的工具，优化也不仅限于一次性的决策支持。相反，它们被嵌入到一个运行循环中，AI 代理会不断感知工厂状态、对结构化的工业数据进行推理、调用专门的优化和预测模块，并在安全约束下生成或推荐行动。The methodologies reviewed in the previous sections—stochastic simulation, stochastic optimization, Markov decision processes, and gradient-based learning—provide the algorithmic foundations for a new class of intelligent industrial systems. In such systems, simulation is not merely a tool for offline analysis, and optimization is not limited to one-shot decision support. Rather, they are embedded into an operational loop in which AI agents continuously perceive the factory state, reason over structured industrial data, call specialized optimization and prediction modules, and generate or recommend actions under safety constraints.

最近工业实践带来的一个核心见解是，仅有强大的基础模型不足以在制造环境中可靠部署。同样重要的是一个工程层，把模型和工厂数据、操作工具、专家知识、执行逻辑以及安全约束连接起来。这个层可以被看作是一个代理框架：一个系统级基础设施，使AI代理能够以可控、可审计和可重复使用的方式与工业环境互动。从这个角度看，代理并不是一个独立的大型语言模型，而是建立在仿真、优化和结构化操作知识之上的复合决策系统。A central insight emerging from recent industrial practice is that strong foundation models alone are insufficient for reliable deployment in manufacturing environments. What is equally important is an engineering layer that connects models to plant data, operational tools, expert knowledge, execution logic, and safety constraints. This layer can be viewed as an agent harness: a system-level infrastructure that enables AI agents to interact with industrial environments in a controllable, auditable, and reusable way. In this perspective, the agent is not a standalone large language model, but a composite decision-making system built on top of simulation, optimization, and structured operational knowledge.

本节展示了三种互补的工业人工智能系统示例。第一个是用于数字工厂的工业代理框架，它将数据建模、数字孪生、混合代理、技能和安全机制整合到一个统一的框架中。第二个是PMC（生产计划与控制）代理，它演示了人工智能代理如何在多品种、小批量、高度定制的制造环境中支持计划任务。第三个是基于世界模型的布局生成框架，它展示了如何直接从异构工程输入构建可用于仿真的数字工厂环境。这些例子一起展示了本章开发的概念如何组合成可部署的工业智能系统。This section presents three complementary examples of such industrial AI systems. The first is an industrial agent harness for digital factories, which integrates data modeling, digital twins, hybrid agents, skills, and safety mechanisms into a unified framework. The second is a PMC (production planning and control) agent, which illustrates how AI agents can support planning tasks in high-mix, low-volume, and highly customized manufacturing settings. The third is a world-model-based layout generation framework, which shows how simulation-ready digital factory environments can be constructed directly from heterogeneous engineering inputs. Together, these examples show how the concepts developed throughout this chapter can be assembled into deployable industrial intelligence systems.

2.8.1 数字工厂的工业智能体运行框架2.8.1 Industrial Agent Harness for Digital Factories

在工业环境中部署 AI 代理的一个主要障碍不仅仅是模型能力的问题，更在于缺乏一种将模型与工厂环境连接起来的可复用基础设施。在许多工厂里，数据仍然分散在运营技术（OT）和信息技术（IT）系统中，不同工厂的接口各不相同，专家知识往往是隐性而非正式化的，并且初始化数字模型的成本很高。因此，工业 AI 解决方案往往是针对具体项目的，很难在不同工厂间推广。工业代理平台通过提供一个通用层来解决这个问题，这一层能标准化数据访问、上下文构建、工具调用、知识封装以及操作保障。A major obstacle to deploying AI agents in industrial settings is not merely model capability, but the lack of a reusable infrastructure that connects models to factory environments. In many plants, data remain fragmented across operational technology (OT) and information technology (IT) systems, interfaces differ from one site to another, expert knowledge is tacit rather than formalized, and the cost of initializing digital models is substantial. As a result, industrial AI solutions often remain project-specific and difficult to scale across factories. The industrial agent harness addresses this problem by providing a common layer that standardizes data access, context construction, tool invocation, knowledge encapsulation, and operational safeguards.

所提出的系统是建立在几个原则上的。首先，智能体被看作是模型和系统的结合体，其中模型可以随着时间更换，但系统提供了与工厂的持久工程接口。第二，整体架构是混合型的：常规且结构化的任务由确定性模块处理，比如规则引擎、运筹学求解器、强化学习策略或专门的机器学习模型，而大型语言模型则用于理解意图、模块间协调、处理异常情况以及解释说明。第三，系统依赖于结构化工作流编排，其中预定义的执行图支持常规操作，并且当出现干扰或异常事件时会触发动态重新规划。 第四，专家知识被封装在可重复使用的技能中，这些技能是按需加载的，而不是一次性注入模型上下文的。The proposed harness is built on several principles. First, the agent is viewed as the combination of a model and a harness, where the model may be replaced over time, but the harness provides the persistent engineering interface to the factory. Second, the overall architecture is hybrid: routine and well-structured tasks are handled by deterministic modules such as rule engines, operations research solvers, reinforcement learning policies, or specialized machine learning models, while large language models are reserved for intent understanding, cross-module coordination, exception handling, and explanation. Third, the system relies on structured workflow orchestration, in which predefined execution graphs support routine operation and dynamic replanning is triggered when disturbances or abnormal events arise. Fourth, expert knowledge is encapsulated in reusable skills, which are loaded on demand rather than injected into the model context all at once.

从代理的角度来看，要进行有效的工业决策至少需要三个层面的上下文。第一个是静态模型层，它描述了工厂相对持久的结构，包括设备、工艺流程和拓扑结构。第二个是实时状态层，它反映系统当前的运行状态，比如机器状态、库存水平、生产进度或传感器测量值。第三个是历史经验层，它存储过去的决策、校准参数以及成功的恢复路径。这三个层面共同为代理提供了感知和记忆：静态层告诉代理工厂是什么样子的，动态层告诉它现在发生了什么，历史层告诉它以前什么方法是有效的。From the agent’s perspective, effective industrial decision-making requires at least three layers of context. The first is a static model layer, which describes the relatively persistent structure of the plant, including equipment, process flow, and topology. The second is a real-time state layer, which captures the current operating condition of the system, such as machine status, inventory levels, production progress, or sensor measurements. The third is a historical experience layer, which stores past decisions, calibrated parameters, and successful recovery paths. Together, these three layers provide the agent with both perception and memory: the static layer tells the agent what the factory is, the dynamic layer tells it what is happening now, and the historical layer tells it what has worked before.

构建这个环境需要一个逐步的建模流程。第一阶段把工程图纸，比如 CAD 文件，转换成工厂设备和空间布局的结构化表示。第二阶段通过协议适配和数据通道绑定，将物理设备连接起来。第三阶段引入生产数据，包括物料清单、工艺参数、物流信息和运营目标。第四阶段进行基于仿真的校准和验证，这样生成的数字孪生就可以作为下游决策支持和代理执行的可靠基础。这四阶段的过程很重要，因为它降低了部署门槛：不必一开始就要求有一个完全详细的数字工厂，它允许代理环境逐步构建。Constructing this context requires a gradual modeling pipeline. The first stage converts engineering drawings such as CAD files into structured representations of factory assets and spatial layouts. The second stage connects physical devices through protocol adaptation and data channel binding. The third stage introduces production data, including bills of materials, process parameters, logistics information, and operational targets. The fourth stage performs simulation-based calibration and validation so that the resulting digital twin can serve as a reliable baseline for downstream decision support and agent execution. This four-stage process is important because it reduces the deployment barrier: rather than demanding a fully detailed digital factory from the outset, it allows the agent environment to be built incrementally.

一旦工厂的表示可用，不同类别的智能体就可以组织成一个混合决策架构。基于规则的智能体负责阈值触发的监控、报警、补充逻辑和合规性检查。运筹学模块解决结构化的规划问题，比如生产排程和路径优化。强化学习智能体在动态环境中调整控制策略，例如在干扰发生后调整局部调度或节奏决策。专门的机器学习模型支持预测性维护和视觉检查等任务。大语言模型扮演的角色则不同：它解读人的意图，整合工厂状态、订单需求、库存和产能的信息，协调调用专门模块，并以人类可读的形式解释最终决策。换句话说，LLM 并不会取代优化或仿真； 相反，它协调它们。Once the plant representation is available, different classes of agents can be organized into a hybrid decision architecture. Rule-based agents handle threshold-triggered monitoring, alarms, refilling logic, and compliance checks. Operations research modules solve structured planning problems such as production scheduling and routing. Reinforcement learning agents adapt control policies in dynamic settings, for example by adjusting local dispatching or pacing decisions after disturbances. Specialized machine learning models support tasks such as predictive maintenance and visual inspection. The large language model plays a different role: it interprets human intent, synthesizes information across plant status, order demand, inventory, and capacity, coordinates the invocation of specialized modules, and explains the resulting decisions in a human-readable form. In other words, the LLM does not replace optimization or simulation; rather, it orchestrates them.

这个架构的一个关键机制是技能系统。系统技能编码了工厂的表示方式以及代理生态系统的运行方式，包括数据模型结构、拓扑语义、协议配置和协调逻辑。业务技能则编码了特定领域的流程，比如调度规则、故障诊断工作流程、可追溯性要求、操作约束和校准参数。为了高效管理上下文，技能会逐步加载。启动时，只保留精简的技能描述。完整的指令和相关参考资料只有在任务激活相应技能时才会注入到模型上下文中，并且之后可能被释放。这种设计在减少上下文负担的同时，也能在需要时访问详细的工业知识。A key mechanism in this architecture is the skill system. System skills encode how the factory is represented and how the agent ecosystem operates, including data model structure, topology semantics, protocol configuration, and coordination logic. Business skills encode domain-specific procedures, such as scheduling rules, fault diagnosis workflows, traceability requirements, operating constraints, and calibration parameters. To manage context efficiently, skills are loaded progressively. At startup, only compact skill descriptions are retained. Full instructions and associated references are injected into the model context only when a task activates the corresponding skill, and they may be released afterward. This design reduces context overload while preserving access to detailed industrial knowledge when needed.

这个系统还需要工作流管理和内存控制。有向无环图（DAG）可以作为普通流程执行的骨架，把约束检查、调度、基于仿真的验证和报告连接成一个持久的管道。当出现异常时，大语言模型可以介入，诊断中断，重新组织工作流，并从检查点继续执行。因为工业代理通常是连续运行的，情境管理就变得很重要：最近的目标和关键交互历史应该保持直接可用；较早的决策可以压缩成结构化摘要；原始日志和传感器数据流应转存到外部存储，同时保留检索路径。这种分层内存策略对于避免长时间操作中的情境饱和是必要的。The harness also requires workflow management and memory control. A directed acyclic graph (DAG) can serve as the backbone for normal process execution, linking constraint checking, scheduling, simulation-based validation, and reporting into a persistent pipeline. When exceptions occur, the large language model can intervene, diagnose the disruption, reorganize the workflow, and resume execution from checkpoints. Because industrial agents often run continuously, context management becomes essential: recent goals and critical interaction history should remain directly available; older decisions can be compressed into structured summaries; raw logs and sensor streams should be offloaded to external storage while preserving retrieval paths. This layered memory strategy is necessary to avoid context saturation during long-horizon operation.

最后，没有强大的安全保障，任何工业代理架构都是不可行的。在制造环境中，错误的操作可能会损坏设备，浪费生产，或给人工操作员带来危险。因此，这种架构采用了多层安全措施。一层是渐进信任，代理可以先执行监控和建议功能，然后才被允许参与协作或自主控制。第二层是操作验证，不同类别的操作需要不同的确认机制。第三层是基于模拟的验证：生产操作应该先在数字孪生中测试，再在实际工厂中执行。尤其是，AI层与最低级控制系统之间保持了严格的边界，这样代理就不会直接向工业控制器发出不安全的指令。 这说明了工业人工智能的一个重要原则：安全不是事后的考虑，而是系统架构本身的一部分。Finally, no industrial agent architecture is viable without a strong safety harness. In manufacturing environments, incorrect actions may damage equipment, waste production, or create hazards for human operators. For this reason, the architecture adopts multiple safety layers. One layer is progressive trust, where the agent may begin with monitoring and recommendation functions before being allowed to participate in collaborative or autonomous control. A second layer is operation verification, where different classes of actions require different confirmation mechanisms. A third layer is simulation-based validation: production actions should first be tested in the digital twin before execution in the physical plant. In particular, a hard boundary is maintained between the AI layer and the lowest-level control systems, so that the agent does not directly issue unsafe commands to industrial controllers. This illustrates an important principle of industrial AI: safety is not an afterthought but part of the system architecture itself.

总体来说，工业代理平台提供了一个具体的例子，展示了如何将仿真、优化、数字孪生和人工智能整合到实际的工业操作系统中。这样一个框架的主要贡献不在于任何单一模型，而在于模型、工厂数据、工业工具和安全约束之间可重用接口的工程设计。Overall, the industrial agent harness provides a concrete example of how simulation, optimization, digital twins, and AI can be integrated into a practical industrial operating system.
